name: Chart, timeframe bias and market context

features.how_to_use: Open Chart for the workspace-selected market (no market picker is in this audited screen); check provider/status and quote source/age; tap 1m, 5m, 15m, 1h, 4h, 1d or 1w. Use Open context → Explicit Sample chart only to explore marked demo bars, then turn it off for source analysis.
features.limits: Real bars require an accepted instrument and reachable/entitled feed; quote availability is separate. Sample bars are generated demonstrations, not evidence. Weekly support depends on source calendar; broker/non-crypto weekly paths can be refused where session calendars are undeclared.
features.name: Selected market, feed status, quote and chart timeframe
features.next_action: Verify source and timestamps, then inspect actual bars or compare timeframe-bias rows.
features.output: Provider symbol/name, quote and historical candles/status where available. Source code requests up to 300 chart bars; Coinbase may stream a current tick into the forming chart candle.
features.purpose: Identify the current instrument/bar interval and distinguish quote freshness from historical candle data.

features.how_to_use: Tap a candle/crosshair to inspect; drag/pinch to navigate; use − to show more candles, + to show fewer, Latest to reset, and Details for source, OHLC, levels and indicator names. If canvas fails, Retry chart or Use SVG fallback; Retry canvas returns from fallback.
features.limits: Actual bars require source candles. Live quote does not mean historical bars are current; canvas timestamps use device time. SVG fallback lacks some canvas-only features, including AI forecast display.
features.name: Candlestick canvas, inspection, navigation, details and renderer recovery
features.next_action: Check the inspected bar's timestamp/source and compare its price with relevant context.
features.output: Candlesticks, source label, actual inspected OHLC and overlays. The primary chart uses an isolated Lightweight Charts surface; SVG fallback is explicitly labelled and display-only.
features.purpose: Inspect actual OHLC and navigate chart history without treating the display as an execution surface.

features.how_to_use: Expand Chart tools & levels; toggle Regular FVG + CE zones, Range quarters + OTE, Manual named levels, or Previous provider day PDH/PDL. Tap Add named level, enter a name and positive price, then Save manual level. Use Details to inspect supplied prices.
features.limits: Manual levels require a positive finite number and active strategy; visibility is strategy-scoped. PDH/PDL requires completed provider-day data. Sample-mode geometry is not market evidence.
features.name: Chart overlays and named price annotations
features.next_action: Compare a level with actual candles and source detail; disable overlays that obscure price.
features.output: Deterministic three-bar gaps/CE, visible-bar range ratios, enabled named/provider-day lines, and separate strategy-derived zones.
features.purpose: View FVG/CE, range ratios, provider-day levels, manual levels and setup zones in price context.

features.name: Optional session background boxes
features.purpose: Make regional time-of-day activity windows easy to see behind actual candles without turning them into trade signals.
features.how_to_use: Tap Sessions below the chart to turn all boxes on/off. In Details, select Asia, London, New York and optional Sydney. Preferences save locally; Open context → Save to cloud syncs them explicitly.
features.output: Subtle colored outlined time rectangles behind the price candles, with compact names; overlapping windows blend softly and follow regional IANA timezone/DST.
features.next_action: Use as timing context alongside your strategy; turn it off when you prefer a clean candle view.
features.limits: Default regional clock references: Tokyo 09–18, London 08–17, New York 08–17, Sydney 08–17 local time. These are not exchange/broker opening hours or WR1 kill zones, and apply on crypto weekends. Intraday only through 4h; daily/weekly show no boxes. Up to 256 latest session windows are retained from at most 3,000 source bars. Only actual supplied history/current observed time is shaded; projection/replay future space and price scale are unchanged.

features.how_to_use: Turn off Sample mode, then read the seven completed-bar rows. Refresh/pull to refresh and open Bias details for rule, source, as-of and warm-up. Sample mode is explicitly unavailable for real evidence, not an endless Checking state.
features.limits: Requires owner access allowed by server, supported market/feed and 55 eligible completed bars per frame. Forming/future, invalid and duplicate bars are excluded; gaps are warned, never filled. Freshness limit is max(3 bars, 15 minutes); fetch has three concurrent workers and 25-second budget. Coinbase crypto weekly uses up to 900 daily bars aggregated into exact Monday weeks. Operational classification is not calibrated/out-of-sample validation, recommendation, eligibility check or multi-leg/queued order functionality.
features.name: Closed-bar timeframe bias table
features.next_action: Compare timeframe alignment and verify source timestamps; wait for enough fresh bars or treat disagreement as context for further review.
features.output: Bullish only for close > EMA20 > EMA50 and rising EMA20 versus five completed bars ago; Bearish requires exact inverse; otherwise Mixed/neutral. Insufficient means no valid completed data, fewer than 55 completed bars, or incomplete EMA inputs. Stale exceeds the freshness threshold; Unavailable means fetch failure/timeout.
features.purpose: Answer whether completed bars on each interval meet a simple aligned trend rule, are mixed, or lack usable evidence.

features.how_to_use: Read pinned CLOSED BARS and PREVIOUS PROVIDER DAY; expand Historical profile & clocks for basis, source/as-of, day timestamps, London/New York/Tokyo and device clocks. Use Open context to choose New York (DST) or Fixed EST.
features.limits: Profile/day values require completed provider/setup history; missing fields remain Unknown/unavailable. Clock preference changes strategy-clock interpretation, not source bar timestamps.
features.name: Pinned historical profile, previous provider day and clocks
features.next_action: Verify time basis and provider source before interpreting session boundaries or day levels.
features.output: Profile bias or Unknown, PDH/PDL or unavailable, source/timestamps, session window and clocks; clocks refresh every 15 seconds.
features.purpose: Show broad setup-analysis profile, prior provider-day high/low, session window and strategy/device clock context.

features.how_to_use: Scroll to and expand Calendar & COT context; review event date/time-known, country, actual/expected/prior when supplied, impact and source; then review COT report date, commercial long/short, units and source.
features.limits: Requires backend access; FMP path needs read-only key/entitlement. Coverage may be partial and not instrument-specific. COT is dated weekly futures positioning, not spot holdings, all-market positioning, live flow or directional bias.
features.name: Economic calendar and COT context
features.next_action: Check source, event time-known and report date/vintage; consult the named source for time-sensitive or instrument-specific decisions.
features.output: At most 10 displayed events and 6 COT rows. Without FMP key, public fallback is a finite US subset (BLS/BEA schedules, Fed FOMC dates) plus one verified CME Bitcoin futures COT record; it leaves forecast/actual/prior surprises unavailable. FMP key path uses FMP calendar/COT endpoints.
features.purpose: Review dated macro schedules and reported positioning as context for the selected market.

features.how_to_use: Tap Open context; toggle Explicit Sample chart, select New York (DST) or Fixed EST, or deliberately tap Save to cloud/Load cloud and read the returned message.
features.limits: Actual analysis requires source data; cloud operations require owner-authorized connectivity. This is not a provider-connection wizard.
features.name: Open context settings sheet
features.next_action: Disable Sample before real-data analysis; verify provider access and cloud status.
features.output: Workspace sample/timezone setting changes and explicit cloud action status.
features.purpose: Make sample-data and strategy-clock assumptions explicit and provide deliberate workspace save/load actions.

features.name: Candle observations
features.purpose: Learn what the latest completed candle shape shows without treating morphology as an entry signal.
features.how_to_use: Expand the panel, read each shape name/side and its explicit evidence; open the pattern catalog/uploads to study definitions.
features.output: App-defined closed-bar morphology or an explicit no-supported-observation message.
features.next_action: Compare the candle with broader context and the strategy checklist; a shape alone does not approve a trade.
features.limits: Not TA-Lib-equivalent thresholds, reviewed photo recognition, confluence scoring, probability or a ready trade. Sample-mode observations remain demonstrative.

features.name: Reference picture / template
features.purpose: Compare an owner-reviewed original picture with the chart while preserving its original pixels and meaning.
features.how_to_use: Upload/review a matching source in My Library, expand this panel and select an eligible image; No reference removes it. Read protected-source errors if access fails.
features.output: An owner-authorized reference image/template; aspect ratio and source identity remain distinct from the actual price/time geometry.
features.next_action: Use it for visual study and inspect its source/rules, not as automatic price alignment or future evidence.
features.limits: Requires an eligible reviewed same-market/timeframe image and actual owner source access. A template is not recognized price/time geometry, prediction or proof of a setup.

features.name: Reference matching — geometry and reviewed-source AI
features.purpose: Retrieve candidate similarities to your reviewed references and expose what matched or is missing.
features.how_to_use: With Sample mode off and actual candles available, tap Compare live chart geometry or AI compare reviewed sources. Inspect evidence/missing items; Confirm or Reject a candidate, or Source & trainer to review it.
features.output: CV shape-neighbor or AI reference-match records with strategy/version/market/timeframe, evidence, missing conditions and explicitly labelled similarity when supplied.
features.next_action: Check the original and the independently sourced strategy conditions. Retain useful feedback or reject misleading resemblance.
features.limits: Geometric cosine/rule similarity is not win probability, a general photo-trained detector, independent confluence or order permission. No reference or source failure can correctly produce no match; Sample mode disables real comparisons.

features.name: Manual confluence & overlays
features.purpose: Keep your own checklist confirmations separate from automatic source-bound setup evidence and chart visibility.
features.how_to_use: Expand the panel, Review manual factors and mark only what you independently checked. Toggle each strategy overlay to control drawings without selecting it for automatic analysis.
features.output: Manual met/total count and earned/possible enabled weight, plus strategy visibility settings.
features.next_action: Use the checklist as a review aid; use the separate approved confluence gate for strategy-mode paper eligibility.
features.limits: Manual confirmations do not change automatic setup evidence, calibrated probability or server gate/entry permission. Visibility does not select a strategy for analysis.

guide_note: Start with the selected symbol, source, age and completed bars. Expand one chart tool at a time, then compare its output with the displayed source and timestamp.

name: Markets and live source selection

features.how_to_use: Open Markets and read the status message and pill. If sign-in/connection is required, use the account panel below to sign in with the authorized Manus owner account, then recheck status. Coinbase public crypto can be viewed through All feeds without TradeLocker access.
features.limits: Private TradeLocker instruments require configured integration and authorized owner session/account. Status is an access/connection indication, not proof of a fresh price, execution quality, or strategy edge. Router status reports futures:false.
features.name: Feed/account status
features.next_action: If connected, filter to TradeLocker and search/select the intended instrument; if not, verify owner sign-in and the configured integration. For public Coinbase crypto, choose All feeds.
features.output: TradeLocker connected/required state and broker-market count when connected; a status message. The screen reports approximate quote/candle refresh intervals and says broker quote reception time is not a provider timestamp and broker orders are disabled.
features.purpose: Check whether authorized private TradeLocker instruments are accessible and what source path is available before looking at quotes.

features.how_to_use: When signed out, tap Sign in and complete authorized Manus sign-in. On web Preview, if sign-in is blocked, tap Open app in browser tab, sign in there, and continue in that tab. When signed in, Refresh rechecks session; Sign out ends it.
features.limits: Private data remains owner-only. This only documents the shared account component as embedded on Markets; shared account/auth diagnostics are outside this audit.
features.name: Account sign-in, refresh, sign-out
features.next_action: After sign-in, recheck the Markets feed status. This panel does not configure TradeLocker credentials or select a broker account itself.
features.output: Guest/signed-in account identity, CONNECTED/SIGNED OUT state, sign-in/refresh errors; sign-out clears the client query cache.
features.purpose: Identify the signed-in Manus identity and establish or refresh the session needed for private source access.

features.how_to_use: Type part of an internal id, provider symbol, or name. Tap TradeLocker for private broker instruments or All feeds for the returned catalog. Filter by All, Crypto, Forex, Metals, Indices, Stocks, or Futures. Changing a filter/search resets to page one.
features.limits: TradeLocker items require owner connection; FMP-backed symbols need FMP_API_KEY and relevant entitlement. Built-in futures data is not connected; a Futures category or broker contract type does not prove exchange-futures data.
features.name: Feed switcher, search, category filters
features.next_action: Choose a result row or Chart. If a public crypto instrument is absent under TradeLocker, switch to All feeds; if the private broker list is absent, check connection state.
features.output: Filtered matching-instrument count and list. Initial feed is TradeLocker. All feeds includes catalogs but does not mean every instrument has an entitled/working source.
features.purpose: Narrow the instrument universe to a provider/feed and instrument class, then find a symbol by identifier or name.

features.how_to_use: Read the provider symbol/name, source and displayed age below the name, and price/change on the right. Use Previous/Next to move through 12 instruments per page. A dash for change means unavailable, not zero movement.
features.limits: Coinbase is public REST data. FMP quotes require read-only FMP key and entitlement and may be delayed. Server freshness uses provider timestamps and marks stale after 120 seconds (or timestamps too far in the future). TradeLocker uses bid/ask midpoint and response-received time, not provider time or a fill.
features.name: Instrument quote/source/age list and pagination
features.next_action: When the source, timestamp age, and symbol are appropriate, select the instrument and inspect its chart bars. If unavailable, verify feed credentials/entitlement/provider availability; missing data is not replaced by sample bars.
features.output: Formatted quote, source label, age, optional percentage change, category, or explicit unavailable message. Quotes poll approximately every 15 seconds; the client requests at most 40 symbols, while this page shows 12 per page.
features.purpose: Assess whether a source returned an instrument quote, what source supplied it, and how old its timestamp is.

features.how_to_use: Tap the outline star to add an instrument to workspace favorites; tap the filled star to remove it.
features.limits: A favorite does not subscribe to a feed, pin a quote, or create an alert.
features.name: Favorite toggle
features.next_action: Revisit the instrument from the app's separate favorites/workspace surfaces.
features.output: Updated workspace favorite membership and star state.
features.purpose: Mark instruments for later review.

features.how_to_use: Tap the bell. The handler saves a disabled alert using the current quote as the threshold when present, current workspace timeframe and active strategy, above condition, and 30-minute cooldown.
features.limits: The alert is disabled by default. A zero threshold when there is no quote is not a meaningful price target and needs review before activation.
features.name: Quick price-watch bell
features.next_action: Open the Alerts area, review/edit the threshold, and explicitly enable only after confirming the intended price and conditions.
features.output: A newly appended disabled alert definition named '<instrument> price watch'. If no quote is present, the initial threshold is 0.
features.purpose: Stage an above-price watch for an instrument without first leaving Markets.

features.how_to_use: Tap a result card or Chart. Both actions set the selected workspace market and navigate to '/'.
features.limits: Chart availability depends on source credentials, entitlements, sessions, and complete bars. A selected market does not establish a valid strategy signal.
features.name: Select instrument / Chart handoff
features.next_action: On the destination, verify the symbol, source, and timeframe before interpreting its chart or invoking another capability.
features.output: Selected market in workspace and handoff to the home/workbench screen; Chart is not a separate chart-only route.
features.purpose: Choose the active market for subsequent chart/workbench review.

features.how_to_use: Use the displayed selected source, then request bars through the destination chart. Treat returned bars as historical source data and inspect source/timezone/status before analysis.
features.limits: Broker native resolutions are 1m/5m/15m/1h/1d. 4h needs at least three closed complete buckets; weekly needs at least three completed Monday-to-Monday weeks, all seven daily bars, and is crypto-only. Current/incomplete buckets and gaps are omitted, not fabricated. Markets exposes no quant analyzer/backtest/optimizer/signal control; operational data availability is not strategy validation. No multi-leg or queue-order feature is claimed.
features.name: Market-data/timeframe boundaries
features.next_action: If bars are insufficient, confirm the source supports the requested timeframe and wait for complete source bars or use a supported timeframe; do not fill gaps yourself as if they were observed data.
features.output: Coinbase or FMP historical bars, or selected-account TradeLocker bars; 4h can be UTC-aggregated from exact hourly bars. Weekly aggregation is restricted to 24/7 crypto daily bars with exact complete weeks.
features.purpose: Understand which quote/history data and derived timeframes can support downstream chart analysis.

guide_note: Confirm the owner session and feed state before filtering or choosing a symbol. A catalog row identifies a source path; it does not itself confirm a current quote.

name: Strategies, attached indicators, confluence gates, and Quant Lab

features.how_to_use: Type a strategy, style, or rulebook term; revise or clear the text to change results.
features.limits: Search does not evaluate market data or validate a strategy.
features.name: Search saved strategies and source references
features.next_action: Open a matching saved rulebook to inspect it, or add a matching source reference.
features.output: Filters non-archived saved strategies and the source-reference catalog by name/description.
features.purpose: Find a rulebook/style by name or description without scrolling the full library.

features.how_to_use: Tap the button to navigate to /library and use its search flow.
features.limits: No images were accessed in this read-only audit.
features.name: Photo-based search in My Library
features.next_action: Continue the library workflow if needed.
features.output: Navigation only; Strategies itself does not process an image.
features.purpose: Find an existing library item from the separate library workflow.

features.how_to_use: Tap Add [name] for one of eight missing references, or Add all missing source references.
features.limits: The screen warns that support varies. The legacy STDV Manipulation-Range Targets preset is separate from the eight current addable IDs. Workspace limit is 100 records including archives.
features.name: Reviewed style source-reference catalog
features.next_action: Open a reference, inspect its factors, then duplicate it before personal edits or apply it to the chart.
features.output: Adds separate read-only references for Order Block Retest, STDV · VWAP Re-entry, Core Sequence, SMA Crossover, MACD Momentum, Trend Following, Breakout Momentum, and Mean Reversion; existing/archive records are preserved.
features.purpose: Add inspectable reference rulebooks instead of treating a source style as an already-proven personal system.

features.how_to_use: Enter a name and scope/session/entry description, put one rule on each line, then Save strategy revision.
features.limits: Free text is not parsed into a detector. Only explicit supported indicator declarations can add recognized chart layers; manual prose is not automatically marked met or treated as entry permission.
features.name: Create or edit personal strategy rules
features.next_action: Apply the profile for chart review, or inspect/adjust individual factors and weights.
features.output: Each nonempty line becomes an enabled factor; maximum 50 rules. New factors default to weight 10. Editing creates a new version and history snapshot.
features.purpose: Record a trader's own strategy scope and checklist rules as reviewable factors.

features.how_to_use: Tap a saved card, then tap Apply to chart in the card or sheet.
features.limits: No orders are submitted. Unsupported/custom definitions remain unknown rather than automatically evaluated.
features.name: Apply strategy to chart
features.next_action: Review closed-bar setup candidates and overlays on the chart.
features.output: Marks the profile visible, sets activeStrategyId and analysisStrategyIds, and navigates to the chart for analysis/overlays.
features.purpose: Choose which saved source rulebook informs chart analysis.

features.how_to_use: Open a saved strategy and switch Show chart overlays on or off.
features.limits: Visibility only controls drawings; an overlay is not proof that the full source rule passed.
features.name: Independent strategy overlay visibility
features.next_action: Compare the resulting chart lines with the strategy's explicit source rules.
features.output: Visible, non-archived strategies contribute their declared layers to chart display; multiple visible strategies union their layers.
features.purpose: Show or hide indicator layers without changing which strategy is active for analysis.

features.how_to_use: Open a SOURCE REF and tap Duplicate as personal strategy; then edit the personal copy.
features.limits: The source reference remains unchanged; copying does not validate the rules.
features.name: Duplicate source reference as personal strategy
features.next_action: Review/edit its factors, then apply it to the chart.
features.output: Creates/selects a personal copy with independent identity/history and a source attribution string.
features.purpose: Customize a read-only source reference while preserving the original.

features.how_to_use: Toggle Include this factor and enter a weight from 0 to 100.
features.limits: Legacy factor weights are checklist weights, not probabilities or the independently sourced gate. A saved zero weight remains zero when editing rules.
features.name: Factor enable/weight controls
features.next_action: Review the strategy revision or configure the distinct sourced confluence gate.
features.output: Each change creates a strategy version snapshot.
features.purpose: Maintain a personal checklist and its relative application weights.

features.how_to_use: Review the message/limitations and any proposal's current/new weight, present/absent counts, and mean-R difference; tap Accept weight as new revision only if desired.
features.limits: Requires retained outcomes for the exact version. Observed differences are not statistical proof, causal effect, or edge.
features.name: Review-only weight refinement
features.next_action: Continue review and inspect retained outcomes; treat the proposed weight as a hypothesis.
features.output: Accepted proposal changes the factor weight as a new strategy version; no proposal may be available.
features.purpose: Ask whether retained outcomes for this exact strategy version suggest a factor-weight change.

features.how_to_use: Tap Restore vN rules as a new revision for one of the recent history entries.
features.limits: Rollback is not deletion or restoration of downstream records; source references are not editable through this path.
features.name: Version review and rollback
features.next_action: Reapply/review the new revision and refresh any dependent paper proposal.
features.output: Restores snapshot name, description, and factors as a new version.
features.purpose: Inspect prior personal strategy snapshots and restore an earlier ruleset without erasing history.

features.how_to_use: Open a non-reference profile and tap Archive profile.
features.limits: Archive is not delete and archived records count toward the 100-record workspace limit; references show no archive control.
features.name: Archive strategy profile
features.next_action: Choose a remaining active strategy or create a replacement.
features.output: Marks it archived and invisible; it disappears from the active saved-rulebook list.
features.purpose: Retire a personal profile from active library/chart use while preserving its record.

features.how_to_use: Tap the button to open the disclaimer sheet.
features.limits: Quoted source, not app-authored advice; WR1 is not a personal trading system.
features.name: Original WR1 risk disclaimers
features.next_action: Treat it as source context when reviewing the WR1 reference.
features.output: Displays the bundled title/source and quoted text.
features.purpose: Review the bundled original-source disclaimer text.

features.how_to_use: Apply a supported model and inspect each candidate's side and step evidence on chart; refresh/review after new bars close.
features.limits: Still-forming/future bars are excluded; <8 execution bars produces a too-few message, 6 completed hourly bars are needed for hourly context, and readiness is limited to 1m–15m. At most three distinct selected source models are evaluated. Unsupported/custom prose and missing context remain unknown; outputs are not forecasts or calibrated probabilities.
features.name: Native closed-bar setup analysis
features.next_action: Use timestamps/statuses to identify missing prerequisites; do not infer an entry from a zone or overlay alone.
features.output: Core sequence checks hourly context, prior-swing sweep, displacement vs prior ATR, MSS, FVG/OB CE and later CE retest. Silver Bullet requires FVG but session timing is manual; OB Retest requires OB. STDV manipulation-range targets are Fibonacci extensions, not sigma.
features.purpose: Ask whether a supported source setup's ordered conditions are present on completed OHLC bars.

features.how_to_use: Make a supported strategy visible, apply it, then review the line labels and chart; hide the strategy to remove its declared layers.
features.limits: Warm-ups are not zero-filled; EMA50 and five-bar slope need 55 closes, and VWAP requires valid volume windows. Non-Coinbase volume semantics are not established; VWAP is an OHLCV proxy, not tick/trade VWAP. Overlays do not attest full filters or order execution.
features.name: Strategy-attached chart indicators
features.next_action: Check each line against its explicit formula, closed-bar warm-up, source and strategy evidence.
features.output: Trend: EMA20/50 and 2×ATR14 guide; Mean Reversion: BB20 ±2σ and RSI14; SMA crossover: SMA20/50; MACD: 12/26/9 line/signal/histogram; Donchian: prior 20-bar high/low; Breakout: prior 10-bar high/low; VWAP STDV: rolling OHLCV VWAP20 ±2.5σ. Custom text only produces explicitly recognized periods.
features.purpose: See the numerical lines associated with the visible selected strategies.

features.how_to_use: Wait for current market/timeframe analysis; select a concrete candidate side when multiple; choose a native trigger; enable/weight other native steps; Normalize weights if needed; set threshold; check review acknowledgement; approve. Any subsequent edit returns configuration to draft.
features.limits: Only allow-listed candidate-local native closed-OHLC steps qualify; session, clock, HTF metadata, news, quote, manual prose and order flow do not. Needs fresh point-in-time closed bars, matching strategy/version/side/bindings, owner approval, valid weights totaling 100 and at least one enabled met condition. Unknown/stale/pending active evidence blocks. Probability is always null; gate approval never creates order permission.
features.name: Configure and approve sourced confluence gate
features.next_action: Inspect blocked reasons and refresh a paper proposal after saving; treat eligibility only as a paper-review signal.
features.output: Versioned contract and evaluation snapshot containing trigger/checklist statuses, deterministic score, threshold, gateMet, strategyEntryEligible and blocked reasons. Score is sum of enabled met condition points; trigger is separate and must be met.
features.purpose: Answer whether a specific same-version candidate's explicit native closed-bar trigger and weighted conditions meet a review threshold.

features.how_to_use: Tap AI/Ask AI Coach for an explanation prompt, or tap Save current workspace to cloud.
features.limits: This audit did not perform API/database writes or diagnose shared UI/API availability. Coach output is not model validation; saving is not an order.
features.name: AI Coach and workspace cloud save
features.next_action: Verify explanations against source/data and confirm persistence through the app's normal workflow.
features.output: Navigation to Coach or invocation of the workspace save action; gate save attempts report local-retention/cloud-save status.
features.purpose: Ask for an explanation or persist the current Strategies workspace using existing app routes/actions.

features.name: ORB Strategy from uploaded video
features.purpose: Apply a separate source-attributed opening-range strategy with exact video timing and owner-approved causal confirmation/stop rules.
features.location: Strategies → Video strategy · ORB → Configure ORB; Chart → Setup conditions
features.how_to_use: Add ORB once, apply to1m without changing market. Configure Native ES/NQ or the labelled NAS100 CFD mode; for NAS100 Detect tick and apply selected broker metadata locally. Save the revision/cloud and review the source gate.
features.output: Exact completed08:00–08:15EST range; closed1m breakout → later midpoint retest → later current continuation; actual-mode wick-plus-tick stop and3R. NativeNQ50–150/ES20–40; app-added NAS10050–150CFD-price-point band.
features.next_action: Select the exact NAS100 broker instrument and confirmed tick/config, or connect native futures data. Review required source/gate/risk conditions before paper entry.
features.limits: Native remains default. NAS100 uses actual market-bound broker tick, not CME0.25/display precision/futures equivalence. Explicit fixedEST/DST; no synthetic range, old confirmation, invented Gold/Asia anchor or validated edge. Out-of-band3R still blocks.

features.name: London Breakout AI-assisted source
features.purpose: Detect a complete Asian-range 15m closed breakout with source stop/TP choices.
features.how_to_use: Add/apply 15m; configure midpoint/opposite stop and 1.5R/2R/range-height target; save/approve the source gate.
features.output: Exact 00:00–03:00 fixed EST high/low/midpoint, post-03:00 close and source geometry.
features.next_action: Review source blockers before deliberately arming paper.
features.limits: No coarse H1/H4 three-hour inference, missing bars, invented volume filter or predictive validation.

features.name: Initial Balance AI-assisted source
features.purpose: Detect the exact first-hour range then a 15m/30m closed break using the explicitly selected volume basis.
features.location: Strategies → Session & pivot strategies → Initial Balance
features.how_to_use: Choose 15m/30m; midpoint stop and one-range-height target beyond the broken edge. Detect instrument and fill missing verified settings; choose venue-only or explicitly labelled broker reported proxy. Approved volume≥1.5×prior20 and app11:30 cutoff.
features.output: 09:30–10:30 fixed EST reference, truthful volume/clock/risk, actual tick when required, exact source levels and remaining blockers.
features.next_action: Save the source revision, approve the current same-direction gate, then deliberately arm paper if wanted.
features.limits: Broker reported proxy is not exchange/venue volume and is never auto-selected. Missing/zero volume and incomplete30m periods remain blocked. No institutional/statistical edge claim.

features.name: Red-to-Green / Green-to-Red AI-assisted source
features.purpose: Detect an observed same-source PDC quote cross with actual opening, selected relative-volume basis and complete morning risk.
features.how_to_use: Choose1m/5m; Detect instrument → Fill missing verified settings → Save. Supported price tick/provider-day PDC/dynamic actual PDH/PDL populate without freezing target prices. Personal session, tick and key-target overrides remain.
features.output: One timestamped sampled crossing, transparent provider-day PDC, actual morning extreme plus true tick, dynamic/manual source targets and precise blockers.
features.next_action: Deliberately choose broker reported proxy only if desired; save/reapprove native source and arm paper separately.
features.limits: Provider UTC trading-day close is not US RTH or settlement. No invented calendar/previous quote/key/premarket level, first-tick guarantee or stale crossing reuse. Actual source volume/tick/daily data must exist.

guide_note: Open one rulebook, inspect its versioned factors, then apply it to the chart. Keep manual checklist entries separate from source-bound analysis.

name: Pattern/style Library upload and structured learning

features.how_to_use: Tap Patterns or Styles, search by name/tag/notes/description, then tap a result card to open its trainer sheet.
features.limits: A listed reference is not a signal or proof of edge. No upload, owner database/API operation, or source-image access was performed in this audit.
features.name: Browse and search personal patterns/styles
features.next_action: Open the relevant record and inspect its original, rules, feedback, and status before accepting it.
features.output: Matching source/manual references with market, timeframe, filename, review status, tags, description, visual-index status, feedback count, and version.
features.purpose: Find an existing personal pattern reference or trading-style definition to review or use in a separate strategy workflow.

features.how_to_use: For a file: Files → Choose compatible file → choose Pattern picture or Trading style → enter a name and annotation/rules → review displayed strategy/market/timeframe → Upload & analyze source. For manual: omit file, enter a name and optional one-rule-per-line notes, then Save local manual definition.
features.limits: File types: PNG, JPEG, WebP, PDF, TXT, Markdown, JSON. Needs a valid active strategy and owner-authorized session for cloud source actions; managed AI model availability is required for extraction. Text/PDF needs extractable text; scanned PDFs can fail. Blueprint scan has an 8 MiB byte limit.
features.name: Upload a pattern/style source or save a manual definition
features.next_action: Open the record and compare extracted candidates to the source; edit rules and explicitly accept only after review.
features.output: File flow creates an uploaded source and candidate description/rules/tags/limitations in review or failed state; a manual definition is a local, non-AI-analyzed record. File sources are retained in protected storage, associated to current market/timeframe/active strategy.
features.purpose: Create a personal reference from a chart picture or written source, or record a definition without sending a file for AI extraction.

features.how_to_use: Open a record; edit Candidate rules one per line; optionally add correction notes; tap Positive, Negative, or Correction. For a file-backed record, use Open protected source; if a newer version is shown, use Load authoritative source vN. Uploaded images can preview; text/PDF source rendering is unavailable in this preview.
features.limits: Protected-source access and durable versions require a file-backed source and owner authorization. Manual definitions have no original file and feedback remains local. Feedback accompanies later comparisons; it is not foundation-model retraining or verified learning improvement.
features.name: Trainer: edit rules, label feedback, inspect source and versions
features.next_action: Reconcile the displayed rules against the authoritative original and then choose the appropriate acceptance action.
features.output: Saved feedback labels and version counts; file-backed changes use a versioned source revision. Source versions, statuses, and label counts are displayed after source access.
features.purpose: Resolve what a reference actually says, record positive/negative/correction feedback, and track the authoritative source revision.

features.how_to_use: Open a file-backed record → Scan strategy blueprint → expand Trigger & confluence blueprint and Missing inputs & ambiguities. Review each condition and source excerpt. Tap Ask AI about this source to open Coach with the source ID and a prefilled question. Manual definitions can be discussed but cannot be rescanned from an original file.
features.limits: Requires an uploaded owner-protected source, available managed model, and successful extraction; maximum source size 8 MiB and analysis timeout 45 seconds. Text/PDF evidence is literal-quote checked; scanned PDF without text fails. Only an exact closed-bar EMA/close above/below comparison with literal period/comparison evidence can be marked supported, and that still does not create a scanner, alert, or order. Image evidence cannot receive a predicate spec. No performance/edge claim is established.
features.name: Library AI structured blueprint and source-specific Coach handoff
features.next_action: Check each claim against its excerpt, define missing data/rules yourself, and use Coach only for explanation. Treat missing or ambiguous requirements as review work, not as a no-trade forecast.
features.output: Versioned unapproved proposal: summary, trigger, up to 24 conditions, indicators/parameters, markets/timeframes, entry, invalidation, targets, risk, required data, ambiguities, evidence excerpts, and weight provenance (source-stated/suggested/not-stated). It adds caution for discretionary, order-flow, quantitative, and ML references.
features.purpose: Answer what trigger, confluences, indicators, entry/invalidation/targets/risk, required data, and ambiguities the uploaded source specifies.

features.how_to_use: After editing candidate rules, tap Accept reviewed pattern or Accept rules & apply style. Separately, an AI blueprint can be converted by tapping Accept as review style.
features.limits: Acceptance is not statistical validation, model training, alerting, or order execution. AI proposal weights remain review prose. Regular style acceptance does make that style the active local strategy, but its use still requires separate configuration/review.
features.name: Accept reviewed pattern/style or save an inactive AI review style
features.next_action: Inspect the accepted style in Strategies, configure supported data and any required confluence gate, and separately establish paper-use readiness. Re-review after a source revision.
features.output: Regular pattern acceptance marks the pattern ready without switching active strategy. Regular style acceptance creates/updates a style with one enabled weight-10 factor per entered rule and sets it as the active local workspace strategy. AI Accept as review style instead saves a hidden inactive style with disabled, weight-zero factors; it checks the 100-strategy limit and avoids replacing an existing source-version proposal.
features.purpose: Explicitly convert a human-reviewed definition into a ready pattern reference or separate style proposal.

features.how_to_use: Tap Photo-based search, choose PNG/JPEG/WebP, wait for the description/results, then tap a candidate. To rebuild a saved image index, open its trainer and tap Reindex protected image.
features.limits: Search is limited to the supplied personal Library. Term overlap or cosine similarity is not live pattern detection, calibrated confidence, or success probability. Catalog/manual references have no uploaded image vector.
features.name: Photo-based personal-library retrieval and image re-indexing
features.next_action: Manually compare candidate source and rules; re-index only when geometric retrieval of uploaded images is useful.
features.output: Query description, matching Library record names/shared terms, and an explicit retrieval-not-detection limitation. Text retrieval requires at least two shared terms, sorts by shared-term count, and caps at eight. Optional visual-neighbor output displays source version and cosine similarity.
features.purpose: Find saved references whose extracted terms resemble an owner-supplied chart image, or rebuild a stored image descriptor.

features.how_to_use: Open the catalog, search, choose All/PD arrays/Candlesticks/Chart structure/Indicator styles, tap an entry for details, optionally open Read source / license, then Add review-only reference. Add all missing references for review is also available.
features.limits: Catalog names do not imply a generic detector. Many entries are manual/source-specific and additions do not create probability or orders. Workspace limit is 500 records; full-catalog add can refuse if capacity is insufficient.
features.name: Pattern & style reference catalog
features.next_action: Open the added record, add source-specific conditions/anchors, review, and save workspace separately if cloud retention is wanted.
features.output: Catalog definition, support caveat, source, and a local review record with notes/rules but no image/vector; indicator styles are typed as styles and other entries as patterns.
features.purpose: Look up definitions/prerequisites and add a review-only reference without an uploaded image.

features.how_to_use: Import CSV with time,open,high,low,close,volume headers or JSON top-level candle array. Timestamps are Unix seconds. Select the actual interval from 1m/5m/15m/1h/4h/1d/1w. Defaults are LONG, hypothetical stop 0.5%, target 1%; change side/distances as desired. Imported history remains in component state.
features.limits: Fewer than 31 bars withholds descriptive stats; fewer than 48 bars yields no qualifying analog candidates. Empty/insufficient means data/sample cannot answer this comparison, not bearish/no-trade. Session gaps are not filled; interval is user-selected. No costs/slippage; probability is hardcoded null; not strategy backtesting or out-of-sample validation.
features.name: Historical CSV/JSON descriptive statistics and nearest-shape study
features.next_action: Confirm source, interval, timestamps and sufficient history. Use analogs as a hypothesis to investigate independently, not as an entry instruction.
features.output: Parser accepts 3–10,000 positive OHLC bars with finite values, valid high/low bounds, nonnegative volume; it sorts by timestamp and rejects duplicates. At 31+ bars, stats show volatility per bar, lag-1 return autocorrelation, and lookback momentum. At 48+ bars, pure helper can show up to five non-overlapping 12-bar-shape analogs and their following 12-bar outcomes. Displays analog/resolved/win counts, dates, shape distances and win/loss/unresolved labels. Same-bar stop-and-target touch is conservatively loss/ambiguous.
features.purpose: Describe a supplied OHLC series and compare its latest 12-bar shape with older non-overlapping shapes and their subsequent outcomes, not issue a live signal.

features.how_to_use: Choose MA cross or 3-bar FVG, enter fees per side and slippage bps (both default 5), then tap Walk-forward test. Defaults are long, fast spans 5/10/15, slow 20/30, hold 12 bars, training 120 bars, test 40 bars, initial equity $10,000. Optional second imported series is separate asset input. Analyst discussion requires signed-in access and Sample mode off and uses server feed, not imported CSV.
features.limits: Requires authenticated private research. Imported history must parse and be long enough for useful folds; component defaults imply 120-bar training and 40-bar tests but this UI does not specify a hard minimum. Discussion is disabled in Sample mode and uses server feed. No result/insufficient fold is not a signal. No execution or calibrated success probability.
features.name: Research laboratory: MA/FVG walk-forward baselines and analyst discussion
features.next_action: Inspect data coverage, fold dates, costs, assumptions, and limitations; compare only as a simulated baseline and seek independent validation.
features.output: Walk-forward cards show per-asset return, drawdown, simulated trade count, hit rate/PF when available, source/bar count, fold train/test windows and selected MA parameters, labels, assumptions and limitations. Discussion shows role summaries, evidence IDs, missing inputs, review-long/short/wait and risk-veto status.
features.purpose: Run a simple historical baseline experiment over imported series, or request a separate role-based analyst discussion from the selected server feed.

features.how_to_use: Choose a JSON file <=8 MiB with instrument/source and 500–12,000 snapshots each containing numeric time plus exactly three bids and asks of price/quantity; confirm dataset permission, sign in, then Run bounded offline book comparison. Fixed defaults: 600s horizon, 1800s training, 10s test, one fold.
features.limits: Requires authorized data, valid snapshot format, owner-authenticated access and sufficient coverage/classes. It is offline label classification; no stored/deployed model, HFT/DMA, queue position/fills, profit, paper/broker orders, or success score. No multi-leg or queue-order functionality is claimed.
features.name: Offline order-book label-classification experiment
features.next_action: Use authorized actual depth data only; inspect temporal coverage, class availability, purging and baselines before deciding whether the experiment is informative.
features.output: If run returns, UI displays five classifier families/six fixed configurations, sample gaps, eligible/excluded rows, chronological train/test/purged counts, label accuracy vs majority baseline, balanced accuracy, precision/recall, confusion counts, and limitations.
features.purpose: Run a bounded offline classification experiment only when the owner has authorized real top-three depth snapshots.

guide_note: Search or open a retained record, then compare extracted notes with the original source available to the owner. Keep a record’s strategy and version visible while reviewing it.

name: Trade screenshot evidence and retained review

features.how_to_use: Tap the Screenshot review heading. In a trade sheet the stage defaults to after for closed, during for open, or before otherwise; standalone Library mode defaults to unknown.
features.limits: Owner-only paper-trading coaching/evidence, not an order-entry or canonical trade-editing feature.
features.name: Expand/collapse screenshot review
features.next_action: Choose a screenshot or reopen a retained source; use Library for general/standalone inventory and a trade sheet for evidence linked to that paper trade.
features.output: Shows the screenshot evidence panel with controls, retained items (if any), and review content.
features.purpose: Open or hide the private screenshot coaching workflow without changing trade data.

features.how_to_use: Tap a listed row; rows show name/version, stage, approval or original status, and a short summary.
features.limits: Owner service returns up to 100 newest items. The compact list starts with 20 and Show more reveals further retained rows up to 100; this is not server pagination. Trade-sheet lists remain trade-filtered.
features.name: Retained screenshot inventory and reopen
features.next_action: For an original without a review, choose context and tap Retry analysis. For a review, inspect the draft/retained review. Use the general Library list to find unlinked items when viewing a filtered trade sheet.
features.output: Loads source metadata and any retained review; restores stage and owner-entered time/timezone when a review exists. It does not display or fetch the original image to the client.
features.purpose: Find previously retained evidence and continue reviewing it without uploading a duplicate.

features.how_to_use: Tap Before, During, After, or Unknown. In a trade sheet, the link checkbox starts checked; uncheck it to analyze as standalone. Library standalone mode has no link checkbox.
features.limits: Linking only organizes evidence: it does not verify or modify fills, stops, targets, outcomes, or execute a trade.
features.name: Stage selector and optional trade linkage
features.next_action: Confirm context is accurate, then upload/analyze; an unlinked item can later be found from Library.
features.output: Selected stage and standalone/owner-scoped linkage are included in the review. The server verifies linked-record ownership but does not send trade fields to the model.
features.purpose: Capture whether the image represents before/during/after a trade (or unknown), and optionally associate it with an existing paper trade.

features.how_to_use: Optionally enter an ISO timestamp ending in Z or a numeric timezone offset, such as the displayed `2026-10-17T09:30:00-04:00`; optionally enter a timezone name. Leave unknown values blank.
features.limits: Nonblank timestamps without Z/offset or invalid timestamps block analysis. A timezone string alone is not proof of the capture timezone.
features.name: Owner-entered capture/trade time and timezone
features.next_action: Use supplied timing as owner context, not as independently verified capture time.
features.output: Owner time is separate from upload time and image-visible time. If the image time is unavailable, the review keeps it null and marks the visibility status; owner time is confirmed only when a timestamp is supplied.
features.purpose: Preserve timing context the trader knows when the screenshot itself lacks a legible timestamp.

features.how_to_use: Tap, select a PNG, JPEG/JPG, or WebP image, then confirm the notice says it has not yet been uploaded. Selecting another replaces the unsent candidate and clears current local source/review state.
features.limits: Maximum 8 MiB; server also checks image signature/MIME. Upload requires an owner session, workspace market/timeframe, and an active strategy (falling back to the first strategy). Image selection alone does not authenticate chart contents.
features.name: Choose screenshot
features.next_action: Set stage/link/time context and tap Upload & analyze.
features.output: A selected filename notice; no server-side source exists until upload begins.
features.purpose: Select a private image source for evidence retention and review.

features.how_to_use: Select a supported image, ensure workspace strategy/market/timeframe are available, set optional context, and tap Upload & analyze. If upload succeeds but analysis fails, tap Retry analysis; retry reuses the retained original rather than reuploading it.
features.limits: Needs owner authorization, current source version, valid retained image and an available supported managed multimodal model; service timeout is 55 seconds. Schema/bounded-review checks reject malformed or unsafe claims. This is not a statistical validation.
features.name: Upload & analyze / retry analysis
features.next_action: Read the draft and explicitly confirm if it is useful. On source-version conflict, reload the current source before retrying.
features.output: Successful analysis creates an unapproved draft. Upload is retained before analysis; a failure notice leaves the original retained for retry.
features.purpose: Retain the original privately and request a structured, bounded coaching review; retry a retained original if analysis is unavailable or fails.

features.how_to_use: Read summary, stage/time status, Visible facts, Textual evidence (location/certainty/unknowns), Confluences, Process lessons and Limits. Compare against independent records before confirming.
features.limits: No screenshot can verify a fill, bracket state, strategy edge, or outcome; displayed P/L/order text is unverified.
features.name: Review draft and evidence output
features.next_action: Use observations only as prompts for manual checking and documentation; compare against independent records before drawing conclusions. Confirm to retain a useful review.
features.output: Separate visible facts and readable text evidence with source location and uncertainty, bounded observations/lessons and explicitly unverified outcomes. A screenshot is not proof of execution.
features.purpose: Separate visible facts from uncertainty and surface process/documentation observations without treating a screenshot as a signal or proof of results.

features.how_to_use: Read the draft and disclosure, then tap Confirm & retain review. Wait for confirmation; resolve a stale-version conflict by reloading/reanalyzing.
features.limits: Does not validate strategy, fill, bracket, or outcome; does not mutate a paper trade or place an order.
features.name: Confirm & retain review
features.next_action: Reopen it later from the retained list as coaching/documentation material.
features.output: Creates a new protected source revision with approved status and confirmation time; UI says no canonical trade fields changed.
features.purpose: Deliberately retain an approved coaching review as a protected source revision.

guide_note: Open the retained evidence, read its visible facts and uncertainty, and attach lessons to the matching strategy version. Treat the image as study material, not execution evidence.

name: Recent analogue scenario

features.how_to_use: Chart → Current historical replay keeps the original current-frame recent-analogue or captured source replay. For extra comparisons, Historical scenario layers lets you choose source timeframe and target chart frames, Add historical layer, then independently hide/remove, select line/ghost/both, color or follow/fixed anchor.
features.limits: Requires actual past continuation; no invented future may be labelled historical. Six additional visible comparison layers / twelve saved overall. Existing scenario direction watch remains on the original replay, not arbitrary display layers; switching chart frames does not delete saved comparisons.
features.name: Recent analogue scenario — show/hide overlay
features.next_action: Review source bars, data gaps and setup evidence manually. If an eligible source continuation is absent, use no replay as a data-availability result—not as market direction or a failed setup.
features.output: Original current/captured replay plus independently saved colored historical continuations on selected chart frames. Source bars and gaps are retained; follow mode translates/scales only display geometry.
features.purpose: Answer what a similar prior 12-closed-bar price shape did over its next 12 bars; this is an analogue, not a forecast or trade signal.

features.how_to_use: With replay visible, tap Line, Ghost OHLC, or Both (default).
features.limits: Requires scenario bars and overlay visibility. This is presentation only; it does not recalculate the replay or create an AI forecast/trade plan.
features.name: Replay display style — Line / Ghost OHLC / Both
features.next_action: Choose the presentation that best supports visual comparison; Both shows line and OHLC ranges.
features.output: Shows a projected close line, ghost candles, or both; the historical / not-a-forecast label remains when replay bars render.
features.purpose: Choose the visual form of the same replay without changing its source or calculations.

features.how_to_use: In real-data mode with at least one analysis strategy selected, tap the button. Then save rules in Alerts and activate the appropriate native-device/deployed scans. The UI says first observation seeds the baseline; local capacity is 100 rules.
features.limits: Disabled in Sample mode or with no selected strategy. Watches scenario direction, not entry/exit. No brokerage or order action.
features.name: Notify me when scenario direction flips — watch rule
features.next_action: Save and separately activate the watch through Alerts; treat any notification as a prompt to review evidence, not an order instruction.
features.output: Creates or enables a local scenario-direction rule. Pure direction classification uses the final replay close versus anchor: over +0.01% up, under −0.01% down, within the band flat.
features.purpose: Create or re-enable a locally scoped watch rule for a direction change on the selected market, timeframe and strategy IDs.

features.how_to_use: Open a triggered alert's Chart view and toggle Show captured alert candles and scenario when captured setup data is present.
features.limits: Only appears for an alert route with captured setup data available. It displays the saved capture; it does not refresh it, create a new replay, or place a trade.
features.name: Show captured alert candles and scenario — route-specific evidence toggle
features.next_action: Compare the capture with its recorded source, strategy version and evidence; distinguish it from current bars and the fresh historical replay.
features.output: When shown, chart uses the alert's captured setup candles and attached scenario when available, independently of current live-chart candles.
features.purpose: Inspect the setup/candles captured with a triggered alert; this is not a newly computed historical replay.

features.how_to_use: Turn Sample mode off, select supported model(s) (up to three) and AND/OR, wait for completed real bars, inspect candidate/messages, and read a percentage only if displayed; otherwise UI reports insufficient eligible history.
features.limits: A percentage requires 100 resolved cases (the collector caps at 100 total) plus a single compatible current direction, executable supported model, sufficient completed history and qualified past entries. Withheld for inadequate/conflicting/unsupported cases; numerical/microstructure references do not have configured strategy-specific outcome evaluation. OHLC-only calculation excludes spread, commission, slippage, financing, fill queue and intrabar order path. Unit fixtures, counts, intervals or rates do not prove edge. No multi-leg or queue-order implementation is asserted.
features.name: Recent analogue outcome profile — adjacent conditional-history readout
features.next_action: Use it only as a prompt for costed walk-forward and untouched-holdout validation, never as a sizing input or claimed edge.
features.output: If threshold is met, shows wins/losses, eligible cases, 12-bar horizon, descriptive Wilson interval and cost limitations. Cases use qualifying closed-bar retest, next-bar-open hypothetical entry, 2R price-distance target and next 12 bars; same-bar stop/target resolves conservatively as loss. Maximum scan 600 anchor opportunities and 100 cases. Probability remains null by design.
features.purpose: Show whether enough qualified compatible setup outcomes exist for a descriptive target-before-stop fraction. This is separate from context replay, which does not require a ready setup.

guide_note: Use this module to compare the current setup with the available recent analogue window. The current source window is capped at 3,000 bars, so the label does not claim deep history.

name: AI scenario

features.how_to_use: Tap the ‘AI forecast scenario’ heading to open or collapse the panel; it is initially open.
features.limits: Disabled in sample mode. Generation also requires live connected market context and the server prerequisites detailed in the report.
features.name: Forecast panel disclosure
features.next_action: If connected actual market data is available, optionally add a question and generate; use results only for conditional planning.
features.output: Shows the optional question and generation control, then generated scenario details and display controls; summary explicitly says conditional scenario, not prediction.
features.purpose: Open or collapse the conditional scenario tool and see whether a scenario is available.

features.how_to_use: Tap the field, enter a question of up to 800 characters, then tap Generate; leaving it blank is allowed.
features.limits: Prompt text is not evidence, cannot supply replacement market data, and does not turn output into a validated forecast.
features.name: Optional scenario question
features.next_action: Review assumptions and invalidation as things to monitor; revise the question and regenerate if useful.
features.output: Text is passed with market data as untrusted scenario instructions; successful output appears as thesis, assumptions, invalidation, and a 12-step path.
features.purpose: Let the trader state a conditional question to guide the AI scenario discussion.

features.how_to_use: Chart → AI scenario layers: select source timeframe and destination chart timeframes (or All), choose Current or explicitly Last available, and Generate AI layer. Each saved layer can be refreshed, hidden/removed and given its own line/ghost style, color and follow/fixed connection.
features.limits: Current mode requires genuinely fresh source bars and quotes. Last available generates a clearly labelled old-history hypothesis without a current quote. Follow reconnects/scales only the drawing, not source analysis. Expired or wrong-market layers are withheld. Existing default historical replay remains independent.
features.name: Generate / regenerate scenario
features.next_action: Use the thesis, assumptions, and invalidation to frame manual observation; do not use the path to place or size a trade.
features.output: Twelve-step AI hypotheses; up to six additional visible layers and twelve saved snapshots overall, with source time, age, expiry and no success probability.
features.purpose: Create and compare independently selected source-timeframe AI hypotheses while preserving their connected line/ghost appearance.

features.how_to_use: Chart → AI scenario layers: choose the source timeframe, select target chart timeframes (or All), choose Current or explicitly Last available context, and Generate AI layer. Each saved snapshot has its own show/hide, line/ghost style, follow/fixed connection and color controls. Refresh expired snapshots rather than treating their old analysis as current.
features.limits: Current mode still requires genuinely fresh completed bars and timestamped quotes. Last available is an explicit old-history hypothesis with no current quote claim. Display-only follow mode rescales/reconnects a saved shape; it does not refresh analysis or validate a prediction. Provider/model access and actual iPhone confirmation remain required.
features.name: Show AI forecast toggle
features.next_action: Keep visible to compare conditional path with actual chart context, or hide for a cleaner view; regenerate if expired or anchor changed.
features.output: Up to six additional visible layers, with twelve saved owner-scoped snapshots overall. Source intervals, expiry and historical/current context are retained; hypothetical OHLC never joins actual chart/source/order data.
features.purpose: Compare separately labelled AI hypotheses from different source timeframes on the charts you choose while keeping the connected line/ghost look.

features.how_to_use: Tap line for the dashed projected close path, candles for OHLC candles, or both for both representations.
features.limits: Presentation only; does not change model output, scenario assumptions, or actual source bars. Projected volume is a zero/display placeholder, not volume forecast or flow.
features.name: Line / candles / both style buttons
features.next_action: Choose the presentation that is easiest to compare with the actual chart.
features.output: A dashed blue line connects anchor and projected closes; translucent blue/purple candles show the 12 hypothetical OHLC steps; both overlays them together.
features.purpose: Choose the representation of the same scenario, not change its values.

features.how_to_use: Inspect each saved layer card or Chart → Details → Timeframe scenario layers for source frame, target frames, source/expiry, visibility and connection mode. Tap the colored chart legend for details.
features.limits: Current mode still requires genuinely fresh completed bars and timestamped quotes. Last available is an explicit old-history hypothesis with no current quote claim. Display-only follow mode rescales/reconnects a saved shape; it does not refresh analysis or validate a prediction. Provider/model access and actual iPhone confirmation remain required.
features.name: Scenario detail and chart readout
features.next_action: Use assumptions and falsifiable invalidation as manual observation questions; assess later actual data independently.
features.output: Per-layer source/timeframe/color and AI thesis/assumptions/invalidation or historical continuation explanation. Actual candles, historical replay and AI hypothetical prices remain separate.
features.purpose: Compare separately labelled AI hypotheses from different source timeframes on the charts you choose while keeping the connected line/ghost look.

features.how_to_use: Tap ‘Remove forecast’; generate again if a fresh scenario is desired.
features.limits: Not an order cancellation or database deletion; audited forecast route/service do not persist forecasts or create trades.
features.name: Remove forecast
features.next_action: Generate a new scenario only if useful and prerequisites still hold.
features.output: Clears local scenario state and notifies parent that no forecast should be displayed; style selection remains.
features.purpose: Clear the current generated scenario from panel/chart state.

guide_note: Read the stated assumptions, direction and invalidation together. This module presents conditional scenarios from the available inputs; it does not turn them into a prediction.

name: Built-in AI trading coach

features.how_to_use: Open /coach. Use Back to return to the prior screen. The route is wrapped in OwnerGate and server calls independently check the approved owner.
features.limits: Owner-only, educational and paper-only. No order entry, broker action, rule editing, guaranteed result, or validation of a setup.
features.name: Owner-only Trading Coach route and Back navigation
features.next_action: Use the lesson library, a prompt suggestion, or compose a question. Treat replies as learning material and independently verify context.
features.output: Trading Coach page with private chat; service offers coach.status, coach.ask, and analytics endpoints.
features.purpose: Open a private learning conversation for educational paper-trading questions, not live execution.

features.how_to_use: Read Checking coach…, Coach ready, Coach unavailable, or the status-unavailable message. If the status query errors, tap Retry context. If service explicitly says unavailable, requests remain disabled until status changes.
features.limits: A successful status check only shows a listed model, not that a real answer will succeed or be accurate. Status-query error and explicit unavailable are distinct states.
features.name: Coach availability status and Retry context
features.next_action: Retry a transient status-query error, or wait and retry later if the service reports unavailable.
features.output: Availability, selected catalog-listed model when available, and an 8-second bounded catalog-check context status.
features.purpose: Show whether a live model catalog check reports the coach as available and provide a way to retry a failed status check.

features.how_to_use: Tap Details to expand Context and Capabilities when those lists are present; tap Hide details to collapse.
features.limits: Disclosure only; it does not fetch more context, alter settings, or validate facts.
features.name: Coach Details disclosure
features.next_action: Use the labels to understand declared service scope; check each answer's context metadata for request-specific grounding.
features.output: Up to eight sanitized labels per list from coach.status.
features.purpose: Let the user inspect server-reported context and capability metadata instead of relying only on a compact readiness label.

features.how_to_use: Tap Explain strategy, Break down confluence, Compare pairs, or Trading discipline. The selected text is sent immediately. In library scope, a fifth source-specific prompt appears.
features.limits: An answer or citation does not validate a setup; prompts do not create orders. Availability of current market context depends on the request's workspace inputs and server reads.
features.name: Learning Prompts
features.next_action: Review observations versus assumptions, inspect citations/context status, and ask a narrower follow-up if needed.
features.output: A coach response to the prewritten question, with model, context-status, and source metadata when returned.
features.purpose: Offer prepared questions for common learning problems: strategy explanation, confluence, comparing pairs, and trading discipline.

features.how_to_use: Type a nonblank question of up to 1,600 characters in the labeled field and tap the arrow. The request includes up to 14 prior turns and the current workspace market, timeframe, active strategy, plus an optional selected source ID. Wait for the pending state to finish.
features.limits: Requires approved owner and local conversation state loaded. Server/model/provider/context failure can prevent a reply. Not a trading signal or execution instruction.
features.name: Question composer and Send
features.next_action: Check returned context/source timestamps and unavailable/stale indications; verify claims against source material and use a manual paper checklist.
features.output: Assistant prose rendered with a limited safe Markdown subset; model name, context-status labels, and server-returned citations/source timestamps can accompany it. Failures show a notice and an unsent question.
features.purpose: Ask a free-form educational trading question and, when available, get a grounded response.

features.how_to_use: When an UNSENT QUESTION card appears, read the error and tap Retry question. It resubmits the same question when no request is pending.
features.limits: Retry may still fail due to catalog/provider, timeout, access, rate limit, or context errors. No incomplete exchange is treated as a completed answer.
features.name: Retry failed coach question
features.next_action: If repeated errors persist, check coach status/connectivity or shorten the question; do not infer a market conclusion from a failed request.
features.output: A new attempt; a successful result adds a completed user/assistant exchange, while another failure retains the retry state.
features.purpose: Recover from a timeout or failed request without retyping the question.

features.how_to_use: Tap Clear when the current conversation contains turns or a failed/pending question. Confirm only by the deliberate tap; it clears this current storage key.
features.limits: Does not clear the server's paper ledger, other scopes/source conversations, or independently prove secure device deletion.
features.name: Clear private conversation
features.next_action: Start a new question or prompt. Clearing is local to the current identity/scope/source conversation.
features.output: Visible turns, failed and pending question states are cleared and the current owner/scope/source AsyncStorage item is removed.
features.purpose: Remove the current local coach transcript and reset the visible session.

features.how_to_use: Open the coach with scope=library and a sourceId supplied by a library entry point. Check the LIBRARY CONTEXT label and source-specific field/prompt, ask about the record, then inspect context/citations in the response.
features.limits: Source ID is not a source upload; file/image bytes are not sent by this coach pathway. Source statements and AI citations are not proof of a trade, fill, or edge.
features.name: Selected-library-source coach scope
features.next_action: Compare the response with the actual protected record in its own view and mark unsupported claims as unverified.
features.output: Compact transcript with selected source metadata grounded server-side; source can be reported unavailable. The source packet excludes fileKey, imageUri, visual index, source bytes and unknown fields.
features.purpose: Ask about a protected library record while keeping its source ID separate from private file/image bytes.

guide_note: Ask a focused question in the active local conversation and inspect the visible turns before acting on an explanation. The current guide records no separate browseable prompt-history library.

name: Paper lifecycle

features.how_to_use: From the chart request a Buy or Sell plan. If source history/proposal fails, read the shown error and tap Retry paper proposal when available. If no proposal is present, return to the chart and request one.
features.limits: Requires an immutable proposal ID and current live quote (≤120 seconds old and not >30 seconds future). Market must support paper valuation; unsupported USD valuation is rejected.
features.name: Request or retry a paper proposal
features.next_action: Review paper mode, risk template and ticket; resolve quote, source or proposal blocker before confirming.
features.output: An immutable proposal ID and, when available, direction, strategy snapshot count, and proposed bracket/size/risk context. The sheet waits for refresh before enabling confirmation.
features.purpose: Ask whether a chart-side Buy/Sell paper plan can be formed using current server quote and setup evidence; no local synthetic fallback is created.

features.how_to_use: Tap Manual practice for discretionary practice, or Gated strategy to request strategy-gated entry. In strategy mode inspect the per-strategy score/threshold/eligibility; if blocked, save an approved gate in Strategies and refresh the proposal, or switch to manual practice.
features.limits: Strategy mode requires canonical saved workspace, matching strategy versions/configuration and current eligible confluence. A gated pending limit may wait with a durable reason if current evidence is unavailable. See paper-gate.ts:16-43, 45-126; paper-service.ts:204-305, 714-741.
features.name: Manual practice or gated strategy mode
features.next_action: For gated use, ensure the approved gate and strategy configuration are saved/current and same direction, then refresh the proposal. Otherwise use practice mode.
features.output: Practice is explicitly not represented as a valid strategy signal. Strategy mode independently rechecks canonical approved rules; missing/pending evidence blocks entry rather than producing an invented score.
features.purpose: Choose discretionary paper practice versus a strategy entry that is required to pass approved, fresh, same-direction confluence rules.

features.how_to_use: Review the displayed discipline panel and tap 1% risk, 2% risk, or Fixed units; wait for the fresh immutable proposal refresh to complete.
features.limits: The UI says fixed units may be below 0.5%, but server cap is 2%; non-fixed edited sizing has a 0.5% reference-risk floor and template-specific 1%/2% cap. Legacy unsupported sheet selections normalize to 1%. This is not broker margin or suitability analysis. See paper-plan-sheet.tsx:74-78, 283-311; paper-service.ts:407-429.
features.name: Discipline panel and risk templates
features.next_action: Review the refreshed entry, stop, target and quantity in the ticket; restore proposal defaults if needed.
features.output: Updated proposal bracket and size. For percentage templates, server may recompute unchanged default quantity against the actual fresh bracket; fixed-unit sizing is user-selected.
features.purpose: Review discipline context and choose percentage-risk sizing or fixed units before shaping the order.

features.how_to_use: Edit Entry, Stop / invalidation, Target price and Paper quantity / units. Choose 1R, 2R, 3R or enter positive Custom R:R; R:R mode recalculates target from entry/stop. Editing Target price switches to absolute-price mode and preserves that direct target. Review displayed actual R:R and any blocker.
features.limits: Requires positive finite entry, stop, target and quantity, valid side geometry and (in R:R mode) positive finite R. Not a broker executable quote, fees/slippage, liquidity or fill guarantee. See paper-plan-sheet.tsx:345-433; paper-service.ts:332-405.
features.name: Ticket: entry, stop, target/R:R and quantity
features.next_action: Correct invalid values/geometry or restore the proposal defaults before confirming.
features.output: Locally parsed draft and actual R:R/geometry status. On submit, market-style entry uses fresh executable side quote (long ask, short bid); eligible unchanged default bracket may be recalculated for fresh entry while edited absolute target is retained and rejected if invalid.
features.purpose: Answer what exact simulated bracket and size should be recorded, and whether it has valid directional geometry and positive risk/reward.

features.how_to_use: Tap Restore server bracket & selected risk; review the restored bracket before continuing.
features.limits: A percentage-template quantity may still be resized against the actual fresh quote on the server; restoring does not guarantee final fill equals the stale draft. See paper-plan-sheet.tsx:157-166, 422-432; paper-service.ts:368-429.
features.name: Restore server bracket and selected risk
features.next_action: Review the restored values and confirm only if still appropriate.
features.output: Restores proposal entry/stop/target/quantity, resets target mode to derived 2R, and clears the current message.
features.purpose: Discard local ticket edits and return to the immutable proposal defaults.

features.how_to_use: Type notes into Optional notes; leave blank if not needed.
