features.limits: Notes are not a gate, signal or proof of strategy quality. See paper-plan-sheet.tsx:71, 184-193; paper-service.ts:517-521.
features.name: Optional pre-trade thoughts
features.next_action: Use the note as a later journal/review reference.
features.output: Trimmed text is sent in the pretradeThoughts journal field; blank input sends an empty journal object.
features.purpose: Record the trader's own reasoning before the simulated trade.

features.how_to_use: Expand Advanced. Choose Market-style or Limit pending; optionally enable Paper bracket management. Confirm, then monitor open or pending status. Do not assume processing while the app is closed unless deployed scheduling is established.
features.limits: Limit entry uses long ask/short bid; quote/evidence and bracket must be valid. Manual open trades do not auto-advance bracket. Missed intrabar paths are not reconstructed; a bar touching both stop and target is treated stop-first; bar range has no intrabar bid/ask. Simulations exclude fees, slippage and invented spread. See paper-plan-sheet.tsx:444-475; paper-service.ts:714-780; paper-lifecycle.ts:84-108, 181-200, 294-421.
features.name: Advanced order style and paper bracket management
features.next_action: Monitor status; review/edit bracket or close open positions through available trade controls. Verify scheduling operationally before relying on closed-app processing.
features.output: Market-style creates an open paper record at fresh side quote. Limit-style starts pending and may open only after eligible observed executable-side quote and evidence. Auto-management is separate from pending limit observation. Open positions can store changing observed MAE/MFE; opted-in brackets can take one 50% 2R partial, move remaining stop to break-even and close on stop/target.
features.purpose: Choose immediate simulated market-style entry or observed pending limit entry and explicitly opt into automated simulated bracket handling.

features.how_to_use: Resolve any displayed blocker, tap Confirm LONG/SHORT paper order and wait for Saving paper order…; on success the sheet reports the created trade through its callback and closes. On failure read the error and retry only after addressing it.
features.limits: Requires proposal ID, fresh live quote, valid market valuation, geometry/risk/gate checks; configured daily drawdown cap/cooldown can block; active paper positions are capped at 100; proposal reuse in a different mode conflicts. See paper-plan-sheet.tsx:167-211, 483-495; paper-service.ts:307-323, 430-489, 493-560.
features.name: Confirm paper order
features.next_action: Review the new open or pending paper record. Pending orders await eligible entry observation; open orders can be managed/closed using supported paper operations.
features.output: A persisted paper trade: open for market-style, pending for limit-style, with risk/quantity, proposal and strategy snapshots, execution-source journal and created event.
features.purpose: Create a durable, owner-scoped simulated trade after the plan and server checks pass.

features.how_to_use: A pending limit opens only when observed quote and applicable evidence satisfy entry rules. Open trades receive quote-sampled excursions; bracket auto-advance requires opt-in. For an open trade, the service supports version-checked bracket edit or fresh-quote simulated close. For a closed trade, save a review; bracket/fill is immutable.
features.limits: Close needs a fresh quote and matching version; pending cannot be manually exited by closePaperTrade. Auto-management requires fresh observations. No claim of background scheduling, on-device behavior, multi-leg orders or order queueing.
features.name: Pending/open/closed trade lifecycle, edit, review and close
features.next_action: Refresh conflicting versions; if pending, address gate/source/configuration wait or keep observing; if open, edit the bracket or close with a current quote; after closure, record a review.
features.output: Versioned trade state, event/revision records, possible gate-wait reason, entry/exit side price, excursion extrema and review text. Manual close is long bid/short ask and explicitly leaves broker position unchanged.
features.purpose: Track a pending limit through observed entry, manage an open simulated position, or preserve a closed-trade review without changing the historical fill.

features.name: Optional automatic ORB paper entries
features.purpose: Place simulated source-gated ORB brackets when the owner deliberately arms bounded foreground automation.
features.location: Strategies → selected ORB → Automatic paper controls
features.how_to_use: Save/review current ORB source/gate; deliberately choose nativeNQ/ES or exact configuredNAS100TL instrument,1%/2%risk and1–3daily entries. Require positive drawdown limit and explicit canonical Arm<=24hours. Old futures consent is not remapped.
features.output: Foreground-only source checks and precise blocked reasons, or one canonical simulated entry/SL/3RTP record per persisted signal identity.
features.next_action: Review resulting paper positions and discipline limits; turn Off to stop new checks.
features.limits: Owner-only paper; foreground/visible checks, no closed-app24/7 or actual automatic fill claimed. Exact same-market source/metadata/clock/3R/discipline and shared-lock/durable dedup remain required. Off does not close existing positions or cancel an already-submitted request.

features.name: Optional automatic session paper entries
features.purpose: Create one canonical source-bracket simulated trade per event under deliberate bounded consent.
features.how_to_use: Save approved source/gate; choose1–2% realized-balance risk and1–3daily cap; arm<=24hours. Foreground default; closed-app permission is separate.
features.output: Fresh source/quote checks, shared lock, durable signal/proposal/order ID, full-position source SL/TP and journal.
features.next_action: Review simulated positions or turn Off.
features.limits: Paper-only; no LLM execution authority, real broker order, generic target substitution or practice fallback. Original ORB consent is not widened.

guide_note: Choose a paper ticket mode, verify entry, stop, target, units and loss budget, then review each recorded lifecycle event. Paper records stay separate from broker execution.

name: Trade journal, deep dive and performance review

features.how_to_use: Open Trades and review the balance card and performance cells. The panel refreshes its clock every 15 seconds and requests quotes for up to 40 open-trade markets; there are no viewing controls.
features.limits: Paper arithmetic, not broker balance; open P/L requires a live quote no more than 120 seconds old and no more than 30 seconds ahead. UTC closed-trade drawdown is distinct from live equity drawdown.
features.name: Paper balance and performance summary
features.next_action: If open P/L is Unknown, wait for usable quotes; use the closed-trade deep dives to review the sequence and recorded context.
features.output: Starting paper balance plus recorded realized P/L; open P/L, open risk, mean R:R, realized P/L, UTC-day closed-trade peak drawdown, and configured paper cap. Missing/unacceptable live quote for any open trade causes aggregate open P/L/equity to display Unknown and identifies missing symbols.
features.purpose: Answer what recorded paper balance, open exposure and paper outcomes currently show—not how a brokerage account is performing.

features.how_to_use: Enter a positive percentage through 100 and tap Save paper limit; leave blank and save to unset. The saved value is displayed in the dashboard and warns when known daily closed-trade drawdown reaches it.
features.limits: Accepts a finite percentage greater than 0 and at most 100; blank unsets. Applies to paper creation, never broker risk settings. Unknown chronology can withhold drawdown.
features.name: Optional paper daily drawdown cap
features.next_action: If the cap is reached, stop creating paper orders and review the loss sequence before continuing.
features.output: Local workspace setting and confirmation message; no broker risk setting is changed. Associated service fixture tests cover paper-order creation being blocked at a saved cap, not broker enforcement.
features.purpose: Set a paper-workflow guardrail for a maximum daily realized drawdown percentage.

features.how_to_use: Tap Pending, Open or Closed (each shows count). Review market, side, strategy/version, date, entry, risk and R:R; closed cards also show P/L. Tap Chart order/Create paper plan to navigate to chart. Pending legacy card opens for inspection; an open card tap navigates to chart. Tap Close at live quote on an open card and confirm to record a simulated exit.
features.limits: Paper only. Legacy pending fill is explicitly archival/unavailable; create a validated paper order from Chart Buy/Sell. Manual close is simulated, not a broker close, and needs a fresh quote.
features.name: Pending, open and closed trade lists/cards
features.next_action: Review closed records in their deep dive; inspect open records on chart. For new work use the validated chart order flow, not a legacy pending record.
features.output: Status-filtered local paper records and counts. Manual close uses a live quote newer than two minutes—bid for longs, ask for shorts—records source/time, and otherwise reports that no synthetic fill was created.
features.purpose: Find plans and paper positions by status, inspect key trade fields, and navigate to chart or simulated close/review actions.

features.how_to_use: Open a pending/closed card or a legacy trade detail. Review strategy version, entry/stop/target/exit, outcome/R and Pre-trade journal snapshot (unfilled entries say Not recorded). Enter a note and tap Save my review. For a closed trade only, tap AI review closed record.
features.limits: AI review requires a closed record and available service. Local save is not automatic cloud sync. Neither note nor AI response verifies a fill, result, or edge.
features.name: Trade deep dive, pre-trade journal and post-trade review
features.next_action: Write a concrete process observation anchored to the recorded plan and outcome; treat AI text as a review prompt, not an execution instruction.
features.output: The note is saved to local workspace with a message that cloud sync is explicit. AI response or error is displayed; response is stored on the record as aiReview. The sheet discloses that quote simulation excludes spread, fees and slippage.
features.purpose: Compare the original plan/journal with the recorded outcome and capture a human post-trade note; optionally request an AI review of a closed record.

features.how_to_use: Tap a market/side/status/date row to open retained detail. Tap Earlier trades for the next cursor page; tap Latest to return to the first page.
features.limits: Requires retained records and a working history service. A local-only manual log may not yet be in durable history; this is not imported or broker account history.
features.name: Full retained paper history and pagination
features.next_action: Open a row to review original journal, events, result and revision trail.
features.output: Paginated durable paper logs and immutable event snapshots, explicitly not broker account history. Empty and error states are represented. The empty-state copy says chart-created orders save immediately while manual local logs archive on explicit cloud save.
features.purpose: Find durable paper records beyond the current workspace list and inspect older pages.

features.how_to_use: Open a history row or Details / working bracket / review action. Wait for detail data. For non-closed trades, edit Working stop/target, optionally toggle Opt-in paper bracket management, edit review, and tap Save bracket / review revision. For open trades tap Close paper at source quote. Inspect recorded events and version trail.
features.limits: Needs working paper detail/edit/close services. Auto-management toggle is paper-only source-quote observation; UI says minimized/closed operation requires deployed scheduling. Do not assume scheduler is running. No broker order, multi-leg execution, or queued broker order is implemented by these controls.
features.name: Retained paper detail, bracket/review revisions and close
features.next_action: Use the event/version trail to compare original and amended plan; keep changes as traceable paper revisions.
features.output: Shows original stop/risk and remaining/initial units, closed net paper P/L/original R, journal, optional generated inspection guide, events and revisions. Save creates a new immutable paper revision; close reports source-quote paper exit and no broker-position change.
features.purpose: Inspect original risk and current paper state, trace record events/revisions, and optionally amend paper bracket/review or exit a paper position.

guide_note: Record the decision context before and after a paper trade, then compare the tagged review with the source version and actual paper trail.

name: Trading foundations and revenge-trading safeguards

features.how_to_use: Expand Learn trading, choose a lesson, read its reflection, then Ask my AI coach. The sheet closes and the correct reflection is prefilled in Coach.
features.limits: Not financial advice, profitability evidence, execution approval, or assurance of a maximum loss. Instrument point value and execution costs still need verification.
features.location: Library / paper ticket → learning and discipline
features.name: Trading foundations lessons and coach handoff
features.next_action: Write down the invalidation, maximum planned loss, falsifying evidence, or process rule to review; use the coach for reflection rather than trade approval.
features.output: Static lesson and reflection text covering risk/invalidation, independent evidence, costs/slippage, forming versus completed bars, loss-chasing behaviors, and review discipline. The coach handoff is a prompt, not an execution request.
features.purpose: Short process-first education for risk planning, triggers versus confluence, costs, uncertainty, post-loss behavior, and honest review—problems that can lead to impulsive or poorly evidenced trading.

features.how_to_use: Open the paper-plan sheet. Read the verdict and UTC closed-record counts. In compact mode tap Show coaching evidence (n) to inspect flags/evidence/next steps or Hide coaching evidence (n) to collapse. Tap checklist rows to mark local reflection prompts, and tap Reflect with coach for a general reflection prompt.
features.limits: Uses the saved cooldown and daily-trade thresholds. Loading/unavailable history is explicitly labelled rather than an all-clear. This is process coaching, not intent diagnosis or trade permission.
features.location: Library / paper ticket → learning and discipline
features.name: Discipline check / revenge-trading safeguards
features.next_action: Review the evidence and data quality; state the setup, invalidation, and planned loss in neutral terms, then decide whether waiting is wiser. Complete canonical record fields when output is unknown instead of treating missing data as an all-clear.
features.output: Record-based loss/pause, streak, trade-frequency and size-escalation observations with unknown evidence explicit. Defaults are 20 minutes and six closed trades per UTC day only when no saved override exists.
features.purpose: Help a trader notice recorded patterns that may warrant slowing down—recent realized losses, a loss streak, high daily closed-trade count, or unusually elevated proposed risk—without diagnosing intent or recommending a trade.

features.how_to_use: Open the paper-plan sheet, tap Advanced, toggle Personal post-loss pause on or off, and wait for the save result. A success message confirms the cloud setting was saved; a failure message says the displayed permission is unchanged. If a paper order is later rejected, read the server's cooldown-until message.
features.limits: Requires authorized owner cloud save and a canonical closed loss within the server's fetched history. This control has no duration editor; it keeps an existing workspace duration or defaults to 20 minutes. maxTradesPerDay is passed to evaluation, but server rejection is based only on cooldownUntil—not daily count, loss streak, or elevated risk. Does not alter broker permissions or guarantee prevention of every rapid-trading behavior.
features.location: Library / paper ticket → learning and discipline
features.name: Optional personal post-loss pause
features.next_action: Confirm save success; during a pause, step away and revisit the written setup/risk after it expires. If save fails, resolve cloud/account/save status and do not assume enforcement changed.
features.output: Saves enforceCooldown and retains cooldownMinutes (fallback 20) and maxTradesPerDay (fallback 6). At paper-order creation, server logic checks up to 100 closed records and returns PRECONDITION_FAILED if the evaluated cooldownUntil is still in the future. This is a paper-service rejection, not a brokerage action.
features.purpose: Give the owner an operational boundary stronger than an advisory: after a canonical realized paper loss, the paper server can reject a new paper order while the configured pause window is active.

features.how_to_use: Tap Learning review · your actual paper records to start the on-demand query. Wait for canonical records to load; if it errors, read the displayed error. Review eligible outcomes, entry-feature and confluence-snapshot counts, then the four fixed score buckets and up to four human-review-only proposals. Tap again to hide the review.
features.limits: Groups under 100 observations are insufficient-data; groups at or above 100 remain unconfirmed, not validated. Present-versus-absent comparisons need sufficient samples in both groups. Missing legacy snapshots are not backfilled and are counted as missing, not absent conditions. No live brokerage fills, execution evidence, causal inference, success probability, or execution signal is established.
features.location: Library / paper ticket → learning and discipline
features.name: Learning review from paper records
features.next_action: Check snapshot coverage and records, document a hypothesis, and reserve untouched future data for later validation. Treat proposals as human review prompts; do not promote a rule from a favorable bucket alone.
features.output: PAPER DATA · DESCRIPTIVE ONLY label; eligible closed outcome and snapshot coverage counts; each 0–24, 25–49, 50–74, 75–100 score bucket's count and descriptive win rate/observed expectancy R where available; up to four human-rule proposal titles, basis and suggested review action; scope text. Server analyzes canonical closed paper records, bounded to 2,000; more history makes the scope explicitly incomplete.
features.purpose: Let a trader inspect descriptive outcomes across confluence-score buckets and see whether enough closed outcomes and point-in-time entry snapshots exist for a human review.

guide_note: Read the current observations and saved thresholds before a paper action. The panel supports process review; it does not diagnose intent or replace a risk plan.

name: Trade/confluence/scenario alerts and delivery

features.how_to_use: Tap New rule, optionally name it, choose a condition, search and select a market, select one non-archived strategy, choose a timeframe, then tap Save local alert rule. Save rules to cloud separately before expecting server scans to use it.
features.limits: Owner workspace is paper-only. Market/feed availability and a valid chosen strategy are needed. This capability places no orders and does not implement multi-leg or queued orders.
features.name: Create a rule and choose scope
features.next_action: Tap Save rules to cloud, then use Test foreground scan or leave the app active for polling.
features.output: A locally stored enabled rule; default cooldown is 30 minutes, except scenario-direction at 1 minute. New-rule UI selects one strategy; it does not offer multi-strategy selection.
features.purpose: Define which market, timeframe, strategy, and kind of signal should be watched.

features.how_to_use: Choose ABOVE or BELOW, enter a finite positive threshold, set scope, save locally, cloud-save, and scan.
features.limits: Stale/unavailable quotes do not trigger. The threshold field names the selected alert market. A price event is not probability or an order.
features.name: Price above / below
features.next_action: Review the event and tap its history card to open the market/timeframe chart context.
features.output: An event when quote.price is at/above the threshold for ABOVE or at/below for BELOW; event records quote price, source/time basis, rule, and strategy version.
features.purpose: Answer whether a live quote has reached or crossed a chosen level.

features.how_to_use: Choose FVG event, market, strategy, and timeframe; save locally and to cloud; scan.
features.limits: Requires usable candle history and a qualifying recent candidate. Fetch failure or no candidate produces no event; candidate requires confirmation and is not a proven edge or order.
features.name: FVG event
features.next_action: Review source and candidate on the chart; independently confirm before any paper decision.
features.output: If closed candles contain a gap candidate ending within the last two candle positions, an event includes gap side, bounds, CE midpoint, and bars.
features.purpose: Watch for a recent deterministic fair-value-gap candidate in candle history.

features.how_to_use: Choose SETUP and scope, save locally and to cloud, then scan.
features.limits: No ready candidate or unavailable analysis means no event. Ready is not validated profitability, calibrated success probability, or execution permission.
features.name: Ready setup alert
features.next_action: Open the event’s chart context and review the captured evidence and source.
features.output: An event when setupAnalysis returns a ready candidate, with aligned supported conditions and captured analysis/source evidence. Candidate identity is used to avoid repeated identical setup events.
features.purpose: Ask whether current analysis contains at least one ready setup candidate.

features.how_to_use: Choose the condition and scope, save locally and to cloud, then scan.
features.limits: Requires scenario/history data; no meaningful change means no event. This is not the same as a direction flip and says nothing about forecast accuracy.
features.name: Scenario shape update
features.next_action: Review the captured scenario and its source against current chart context.
features.output: A historical scenario changed event; the initial scenario can qualify when no previous setup exists. Later comparisons use presence, side, or normalized close-path distance.
features.purpose: Notify when a historical-source scenario appears, disappears, changes side, or materially changes normalized path shape.

features.how_to_use: Choose the condition and scope, save locally and to cloud, then run a scan or wait for one. First successful observation establishes a baseline, not an alert.
features.limits: Missing/flat history does not fabricate a flip. Source/version/context changes reseed; broker market rotation can add latency. The first scan is baseline-only.
features.name: Historical scenario direction flip
features.next_action: Tap the event and inspect its captured line/ghost source; treat it as replay change for review, not a price prediction.
features.output: On reversal, an event captures previous → current direction, scenario/source context, and chart data. Comparison uses a 1-basis-point flat deadband; brief reversals are coalesced by the one-minute cooldown.
features.purpose: Ask whether the drawn historical line/ghost endpoint reversed up/down relative to its anchor.

features.how_to_use: First configure/review/approve a valid confluence contract on the chosen strategy. Then choose CONFLUENCE, set alert points (screen default 70, range 0–100) and met-condition count (default 2, integer 1–100), choose one strategy/market/timeframe, save locally and to cloud, and scan.
features.limits: Requires a valid contract bound to the exact strategy/version, approved status, enabled weights summing to 100, supported native closed-OHLC trigger/condition bindings, fresh same-timeframe closed bars, and a unique current same-version candidate. The score is points, not probability; no signal can reflect missing/stale/ambiguous evidence. No statistical edge or order is implied.
features.name: Weighted confluence alert
features.next_action: Inspect the captured decision/checklist and chart, address pending or unmet conditions, and evaluate performance separately with controlled validation.
features.output: A deterministic weighted score, met/total count, comparison to alert threshold and entry gate, and checklist evidence. Fires only with valid non-null score, approved config, met named trigger, no active pending source, score at least the alert threshold, enough enabled conditions met, and at least one met condition.
features.purpose: Ask whether an approved named trigger fired on sourced closed-bar evidence and enough weighted conditions met an alert threshold.

features.how_to_use: Approve a sourced confluence strategy first; choose BELOW-GATE and market/strategy/timeframe, save locally and to cloud, then scan. This uses the approved strategy entry threshold—not independent alert points/count controls.
features.limits: Requires approved, sourced trigger and usable nonpending evidence. It warns when entry gate is not met; it never grants entry or places an order.
features.name: Below-entry-gate warning
features.next_action: Review why the gate is unmet; do not interpret this as entry permission.
features.output: A Trigger below entry gate event when prerequisites pass and gateMet is false; message reports score against the entry gate.
features.purpose: Warn when an approved sourced trigger fires while weighted score is below the configured entry gate.

features.how_to_use: Tap Enable rule to toggle ON/OFF or Remove rule to delete it, then tap Save rules to cloud to apply the change to canonical server scans.
features.limits: Local edits alone do not update the server’s canonical cloud workspace; cloud-save failure leaves local data unchanged and unapplied to server scans.
features.name: Enable or remove a rule
features.next_action: Cloud-save changes, then scan or leave the app active.
features.output: Rule card shows name, market, timeframe, condition/threshold, cooldown, and ON/OFF state.
features.purpose: Manage whether a configured alert remains watched.

features.how_to_use: After adding, toggling, or removing rules, tap Save rules to cloud and wait for the status message. Manual scan also attempts this first and aborts if save fails.
features.limits: Local rule save is separate. Preview/source publication alone is not a deployed schedule.
features.name: Save rules to cloud
features.next_action: After success, test a scan or wait for foreground polling; continue mobile setup only if closed-app alerts are needed.
features.output: Success/failure message; success persists the workspace through the owner-protected save endpoint.
features.purpose: Persist owner workspace as the canonical server-side rule set.

features.how_to_use: Tap Test foreground scan; it saves first and reports failure without scanning if the save fails.
features.limits: No signal may mean no trigger, insufficient/stale data, invalid confluence setup, budget deferral, or deadline. Same-market broker reads can be reused, excess markets rotate. It is not a closed-app guarantee.
features.name: Test foreground scan
features.next_action: Review history; resolve source/configuration problems or wait for later rotated scans when markets were deferred.
features.output: Returned events merge into history and a message reports scan status, deferred broker markets/timeouts/unavailable rules, and push prerequisites. Server scan has a 45-second deadline and a 12-information-request broker budget including bootstrap reserve.
features.purpose: Check what currently saved cloud rules produce in one bounded scan.

features.how_to_use: No separate button: with at least one local rule enabled, keep the app active; it scans on activation/resume and about every 60 seconds. Tap the displayed error banner to dismiss it.
features.limits: It is not a closed-app scheduler. Server scans read cloud rules, so locally enabled but unsaved rules are not canonical scan inputs.
features.name: Automatic foreground scan
features.next_action: Ensure rules are cloud-saved and resolve any error; use manual scan for an immediate deliberate check.
features.output: Calls scan mutation, merges returned events, and shows a dismissible error on failure.
features.purpose: Poll server-side saved rules while the app is active.

features.name: Mobile push enrollment and schedule activation
features.next_action: Verify a real trigger on the installed device; check OS permission, feed, schedule, and delivery if none arrives.
features.output: Device token enrollment and a once-per-minute owner-bound deployed schedule. Push tap fetches the owner-stored event and opens captured chart scope. Android channel is configured; notification sound and badge are disabled.
features.purpose: Enroll an iOS/Android device and schedule scans while the app is closed.

features.name: Alert history and open event
features.next_action: Inspect captured chart/source evidence and decide independently what paper review is appropriate.

features.purpose: Review events actually emitted and return to their market context.

features.purpose: Monitor enabled source watches from the private published backend and expose actual callback/device states.

name: Quant pairs relative-value model

features.how_to_use: Open the family, Load real-data starter and Run model; use Edit model / markets / settings for changes. In the workbench, if exposed, select exactly two distinct symbols and the same supported timeframe; provide each series with OHLCV candles, source/provenance, fetchedAt, and current now. Recalculate. Inspect source labels, valid closed bars, synchronized bars, and limitations before interpreting later outputs.
features.limits: Exactly two assets, same supported timeframe; latest 5,000 supplied bars per side are examined. Invalid OHLCV, unclosed/future bars, and conflicting duplicate timestamps are excluded; exact duplicates are deduplicated. Gaps are retained, not filled. No basket selection or data fetching.
features.name: Two-asset and timeframe selection / source-quality gate
features.next_action: If insufficient, provide more overlapping closed history at the same timeframe. If unavailable, correct the pair, timeframe, timestamps, or settings. Review exclusions and source provenance; no missing bars are fetched or filled by this model.
features.output: Status/reasons; source/provenance and supplied/closed-bar counts; exact synchronized-bar count and required minimum. Requirements are at least max(100, 2 × lookback) exact-matching valid closed bars. Candles use Unix seconds; now/fetchedAt use Unix milliseconds.
features.purpose: Answer whether two explicit price series have enough trustworthy, same-time observations for a pair calculation; the model does not discover assets or build a basket.

features.how_to_use: Open Edit model / markets / settings. Pair lookback is 30–400, entryZ greater than exitZ≥0, holding 1–100, positive equity/order size and nonnegative costs. The real-data starter uses 60/2/0.5/5/100,000 with 0 bps costs.
features.limits: Generic bps costs are user assumptions, not live venue charges. Inventory/maxInventory do not affect pairs; formal cointegration needs at least 30 observations and is not win probability.
features.name: Pairs parameters / assumptions
features.next_action: Choose predeclared parameters and defensible costs; rerun sensitivity checks. Zero costs means excluded assumptions, not free execution.
features.output: Invalid values return unavailable with reasons. Accepted parameters drive OLS window, entry/exit behavior, replay holding horizon, generic two-leg modeled costs, initial equity and candidate quantities.
features.purpose: Let the trader specify spread entry/exit thresholds, fit window, holding duration, generic costs, research equity scale, and left-leg quantity scale for the calculation and replay.

features.how_to_use: Open the family, Load real-data starter and Run model; use Edit model / markets / settings for changes. After a ready run, inspect the OLS hedge ratio, latest residual spread, rolling z-score and residual standard deviation. Compare previous-window hedge ratio, hedge-ratio drift/stability, and residual lag-one autocorrelation; do not treat the 25% stability label as a statistical test.
features.limits: Lag-one autocorrelation is descriptive, not a unit-root/cointegration test. Stability uses a simple 25% drift heuristic. Matched bars, not elapsed time, define windows when gaps exist.
features.name: Rolling OLS spread and hedge diagnostics
features.next_action: Use z-score as a relative-value diagnostic alongside data quality and the separate cointegration result. If fit or beta is unavailable, resolve insufficient/degenerate input rather than inventing a hedge ratio.
features.output: Hedge ratio beta for left = intercept + beta × right; latest residual and z-score; in-window residual standard deviation; lag-one residual autocorrelation; previous beta, drift and heuristic stability label.
features.purpose: Answer how far the latest matched-bar residual is from its recent fitted relationship and whether the estimated hedge ratio is changing between adjacent windows.

features.how_to_use: Open the family, Load real-data starter and Run model; use Edit model / markets / settings for changes. Run pairs with a valid lookback and enough exact aligned closed history; inspect diagnostic status, residual ADF t-statistic, MacKinnon p-value, decision, 5% critical value, and prior/current comparison. Read the p-value label and limitations before using the result.
features.limits: Null is no cointegration conditional on both series being I(1); integration order is not tested. P-value is not win probability. No multiple-testing correction; gap and structural-break limitations remain. Pair form/model now both require at least 30 lookback bars.
features.name: Engle–Granger residual-ADF diagnostic and rolling warning
features.next_action: Treat rejection only as a research screen under the model's assumptions; investigate data, stability, and validation separately. A fail-to-reject or unavailable result means the pair-signal gate is not met, not that the relationship is proven absent.
features.output: Present-window status, ADF statistic, approximate p-value, selected reject/fail-to-reject decision, 1/5/10% critical values internally (the pairs metrics surface 5%), plus prior-window comparison status and possible-break warning when prior rejection is lost.
features.purpose: Assess the specific null of no cointegration for the current price window and show whether a prior equal-size rejection is lost in the current window.

features.how_to_use: Open the family, Load real-data starter and Run model; use Edit model / markets / settings for changes. On a ready result, inspect OOS boundary, train/test samples, modeled two-leg costs, supplied fee/slippage, equity series, and validation reasons. Compare runs with realistic alternative cost assumptions and inspect whether positions resolve within observed data.
features.limits: Costs are generic user-supplied bps, not exchange/broker/NBBO/L2 estimates. At least 100 resolved outcomes are cited as needed before any performance verdict, but this function does not validate a strategy. No newest untouched holdout, borrow/funding/FX/delisting/survivorship treatment, or forced close of an open pair without a later observed bar.
features.name: Lagged two-leg exploratory replay and equity path
features.next_action: Use as a sensitivity/research diagnostic only. Improve cost and market assumptions and seek independent out-of-sample validation before considering any operational action.
features.output: Exploratory equity values starting flat at the OOS boundary, modeled two-leg costs, OOS boundary, train/test counts, and count of resolved non-overlapping OOS pair outcomes. Decisions use only the decision bar and prior bars and are lagged to the next observed close.
features.purpose: Show a cost-assumption-based historical out-of-sample calculation of what the rules would have done after a training segment, rather than an executable or validated strategy.

features.how_to_use: Open the family, Load real-data starter and Run model; use Edit model / markets / settings for changes. After a ready calculation, check whether two signal records exist and inspect both directions, shared timestamp, strength and reason. If paperPlan exists, review both legs, quantities, and reference closes together. Do not submit an isolated leg based on this output.
features.limits: No brokerage or exchange execution, order queue, multi-leg atomic submission, live position tracking, fill verification, or single-leg substitute. A ready result can legitimately have no signal. Historical closes do not prove simultaneous executable prices, fills, spreads, borrow, or funding.
features.name: Current two-leg candidate signals and paper-plan output
features.next_action: A no-signal result calls for checking z-score, cointegration decision/comparison, data and limits—not treating it as a failure. A candidate can be reviewed as a pair for research/paper discussion only; this module offers no order action.
features.output: Either no signals or two records: positive z maps to short left/long right; negative z to long left/short right, with right quantity scaled by beta. Optional paperPlan has exactly two legs with symbol, side, quantity, and last observed reference close. Strength is capped at 1 and based on absolute z relative to entryZ.
features.purpose: Expose a research-only candidate when a closed-bar spread threshold, current cointegration rejection, and no flagged loss-of-rejection all align; preserve the paired nature rather than suggesting a standalone leg.

guide_note: Load a documented pair and inspect the relationship, diagnostic and costs together. A calculation result is research output that still needs qualification.

name: Quant selected-universe momentum model

features.how_to_use: Open the family, Load real-data starter and Run model; use Edit model / markets / settings for changes. Supply 2–8 distinct symbols, each with source, provider/user-import provenance, the same supported timeframe, positive fetchedAt in milliseconds, and timestamped positive closes; set now in Unix milliseconds. Use closed bars.
features.limits: At most 5,000 most-recent supplied entries per asset are inspected. No interpolation, forward-fill, point-in-time membership, delisting/survivorship correction, corporate-action verification, or total-return verification is implemented.
features.name: Fixed-universe data input
features.next_action: Check symbol membership and timestamp/source quality; fix malformed inputs and missing common timestamps before interpreting ranks.
features.output: Uses exactly the supplied universe; outputs asset/timeframe, source/provenance counts, accepted bars and counts of excluded invalid, duplicate, and future/open bars. Uses exact shared timestamps only.
features.purpose: Compare a small, fixed set of assets on the same bar horizon; answer which supplied assets lead or lag without inventing missing prices.

features.how_to_use: In Edit settings choose an integer lookback 10–252, and enough closed source bars beyond that window. Default is 60. Pure-runner smaller windows are not an app control.
features.limits: Bar-based rather than calendar-normalized; irregular timestamps are reported. No edge is inferred from choosing a lookback.
features.name: Momentum lookback parameter
features.next_action: Use a predeclared horizon and compare alternatives only with chronological training and untouched holdout data.
features.output: Trailing momentum is current close divided by close lookback bars earlier minus one; volatility is population standard deviation of trailing log returns. Lookback also affects signal-strength scaling.
features.purpose: Set the trailing bar horizon for momentum and realized-volatility calculations.

features.how_to_use: In Edit settings choose an integer holding/rebalance cadence 1–100 common bars. Default 5. This does not schedule or submit an order.
features.limits: Cadence is a count of shared bars, not elapsed calendar time. It does not schedule or submit orders.
features.name: Holding/rebalance cadence
features.next_action: Evaluate cadence only with non-overlapping outcomes and documented execution-cost assumptions.
features.output: Changes scheduled rebalance points, turnover costs, actionable-rebalance count, and completed costed interval count.
features.purpose: Set how often the hypothetical target weights are recalculated, addressing rebalance frequency and turnover.

features.how_to_use: Open the family, Load real-data starter and Run model; use Edit model / markets / settings for changes. Set positive finite starting equity and finite nonnegative fee/slippage bps (the code does not require integer bps). Supply defensible assumptions; the runner adds the two rates.
features.limits: Only supplied fee/slippage is charged. Borrow, financing, tax, margin, liquidity, impact and fills are excluded; values are not validated performance evidence.
features.name: Starting equity and fee/slippage assumptions
features.next_action: Replace generic costs with researched instrument/venue assumptions before paper evaluation; obtain execution-quality data for stronger analysis.
features.output: Exploratory final equity, net return, max drawdown, and supplied combined fee+slippage bps. Cost is applied to absolute target-weight turnover.
features.purpose: Estimate a hypothetical equity path using an explicit capital base and user-supplied turnover costs.

features.how_to_use: Open the family, Load real-data starter and Run model; use Edit model / markets / settings for changes. After a calculation, check each signal's as-of time, rank, direction, reason, and strength against its inputs. Treat `flat` as no latest selected target, not a recommendation.
features.limits: Selects positive top-quintile and negative bottom-quintile candidates, inverse-volatility weights them, and sorts ties by symbol. A signal is not an investment recommendation or trade instruction.
features.name: Latest ranks and signals
features.next_action: Verify the timestamp and source bars; use non-flat output only as a paper hypothesis pending independent validation.
features.output: One latest-snapshot signal per asset: long, short, or flat; reason gives rank, trailing momentum and selection/weight. Strength is capped at 1 and volatility-scaled.
features.purpose: Answer which supplied assets are strongest/weakest under the rule and which have a nonzero hypothetical long/short target.

features.how_to_use: Open the family, Load real-data starter and Run model; use Edit model / markets / settings for changes. Review status and data-quality fields first, then actionable rebalances, completed intervals, leader, final equity, return, drawdown, and equity points.
features.limits: No fill, market-impact, borrow, financing, tax, margin, liquidity or liquidation model. The path may halt at zero; it does not demonstrate an edge.
features.name: Exploratory portfolio/equity output
features.next_action: Treat as arithmetic only; test walk-forward and untouched holdout performance with realistic execution assumptions before drawing conclusions.
features.output: A simplified close-to-close hypothetical equity series and metrics; supplied fee/slippage is charged at weight changes.
features.purpose: Answer what the simplified rule's historical close-to-close path and turnover costs calculate to on the supplied data.

features.how_to_use: Open the family, Load real-data starter and Run model; use Edit model / markets / settings for changes. If present, inspect each symbol, side, reference close and quantity as a manual paper-review reference; check shortability and sizing separately.
features.limits: No brokerage action, queued orders, fills, or multi-leg order execution is implemented by this calculation.
features.name: Paper allocation preview
features.next_action: Use only in a manual paper workflow after checking constraints and inputs; do not treat as a broker ticket.
features.output: Optional paper-only allocation legs; quantity equals absolute weight times final equity divided by reference close.
features.purpose: Show approximate quantities corresponding to the latest selected target weights and hypothetical ending equity.

features.how_to_use: Open the family, Load real-data starter and Run model; use Edit model / markets / settings for changes. Read status, validation reasons, sample count and limitations before using numeric outputs. For validation, obtain point-in-time membership/delisting/corporate-action data, at least 100 actual non-overlapping outcomes, walk-forward evaluation, sealed untouched holdout and execution-quality data.
features.limits: Unit fixtures use synthetic data expressly for arithmetic tests, not performance evidence; test passes are not device proof or a statistical edge. Entry/exit Z, inventory, order size and max inventory appear in the test input shape but are not consumed by this momentum runner.
features.name: Validation/status/limitations diagnostics
features.next_action: Collect the listed data and conduct independent chronological walk-forward and untouched-holdout validation; calculation success alone is not enough.
features.output: Ready/insufficient-data/unavailable status; validation is always unconfirmed in this implementation, with zero train/test samples and false walk-forward/holdout flags. Reasons explain missing prerequisites.
features.purpose: Clarify whether an output is merely calculable or empirically validated, and identify prerequisites for stronger claims.

guide_note: Choose the stated universe and lookback, run the documented calculation, then inspect ranks, turnover and the exact source window before comparing results.

name: Quant venue quote and inventory model

features.how_to_use: Open the family, Load real-data starter and Run model; use Edit model / markets / settings for changes. In Quant Lab choose Market making, select a Coinbase-supported crypto product, request/load venue depth, check the returned symbol, source, delivery status, and age, then calculate using that book.
features.limits: TradeLocker `TL:` and other non-Coinbase instruments are rejected. A usable uncrossed bid and ask book with valid actual tick/lot metadata is required.
features.location: Strategies → Quant model studio → Market making
features.name: Venue L2 snapshot
features.next_action: If unsupported, empty, crossed, or stale, select a supported Coinbase crypto product or stop; do not substitute OHLC/midpoint data.
features.output: A book with source label, `polled` or `streamed` status, receipt timestamp, bid/ask levels (up to 50 each), and product tick/lot increments. Streamed WebSocket is attempted first, with public REST fallback. It is single-venue depth, not consolidated NBBO.
features.purpose: Answer whether there is usable single-venue depth and identify the current top levels plus the venue's price/size increments.

features.how_to_use: Open the family, Load real-data starter and Run model; use Edit model / markets / settings for changes. Enter finite, non-negative `feeBps` and `slippageBps` assumptions in basis points, then calculate. Defaults are both zero, so replace those with credible assumptions before interpretation.
features.limits: The calculation has no fee lookup, rebate model, latency cost estimate, or transaction execution.
features.location: Strategies → Quant model studio → Market making
features.name: Fee and slippage assumptions / cost gate
features.next_action: Use defensible product-specific cost assumptions. A no-plan cost-gate result is not a profitable trade or an instruction to loosen assumptions.
features.output: Metrics for each supplied cost and a two-sided allowance of 2 × (feeBps + slippageBps). If spread bps is less than or equal to this allowance, result status is `ready` but there is no `paperPlan`; the result is flat with an explanation that costs consume the spread.
features.purpose: Answer whether the displayed spread exceeds estimated two-sided fee and slippage costs.

features.how_to_use: Open the family, Load real-data starter and Run model; use Edit model / markets / settings for changes. Supply current signed `inventory`, positive `orderSize`, and positive `maxInventory` in units matching the book's base-asset quantity; recalculate. Defaults are inventory 0, order size 0.01, cap 0.1. Verify the position yourself; the module does not sync an account.
features.limits: Inventory and cap units must be consistent with the venue product. This is not account reconciliation or live exposure enforcement.
features.location: Strategies → Quant model studio → Market making
features.name: Inventory-aware quote center and size controls
features.next_action: Compare the assumed position with the real position outside the tool. If no side has one full lot of capacity, correct only erroneous inputs or accept that no quote is proposed.
features.output: A ratio clamped to −1…+1 shifts the quote center away from the inventory direction by up to a quarter spread. Bid capacity is max(0, cap − inventory); ask capacity is max(0, cap + inventory); quantities are capped by order size and rounded down to venue lots. Only sides with a positive full-lot quantity can appear in the plan.
features.purpose: Answer how the supplied signed inventory should shift the quote center and how much size is available on each side under a cap.

features.how_to_use: Open the family, Load real-data starter and Run model; use Edit model / markets / settings for changes. Provide a valid book, settings, positive-millisecond `now`, and `series` array (it may be empty); run family `making`; read the summary, metrics, validation, then check whether `paperPlan` exists.
features.limits: Uses only supplied current L2 and top-five depth; no queue priority, partial-fill, cancellation, persistence, adverse-selection, PnL, or performance model. The cost gate and valid tick/lot/capacity checks must pass.
features.location: Strategies → Quant model studio → Market making
features.name: Top-five depth metrics and passive paper quote targets
features.next_action: Use any legs only as paper worksheet targets for manual review. This module does not place, queue, refresh, cancel, or monitor orders; it does not simulate fills or returns.
features.output: Best bid/ask, midpoint, spread and spread bps, up-to-five-level bid/ask depth and imbalance, adjusted center, and optionally `paperPlan.legs` containing symbol, long/short side, reference price, and quantity. Prices are tick-rounded; sizes are lot-rounded. `equity` remains empty. The signal is descriptive and flat, not directional alpha.
features.purpose: Answer what passive tick-grid bid/ask prices this simple rule would write down from the supplied snapshot.

features.how_to_use: Choose one supported Coinbase product and run. History/timeframe/import controls are intentionally hidden for this family; the service supplies no candle series.
features.limits: Internal runner candle-quality hooks are not exposed as a workbench capability. A real book still does not prove fills, queue priority or profitable quoting.
features.location: Strategies → Quant model studio → Market making
features.name: Current-book-only scope — no candle backtest
features.next_action: Use another family for OHLC research; queue/fill/adverse-selection research needs actual execution records, not reconstructed candle observations.
features.output: A received venue book and book/cost/inventory calculations. No making candle backtest or fill outcome is returned.
features.purpose: Make clear why this venue-quote model uses an actual book, not a candle history or OHLC import.

features.how_to_use: Open the family, Load real-data starter and Run model; use Edit model / markets / settings for changes. After calculation, inspect status, summary, validation reasons, data requirements, limitations, and whether a paper plan exists. Do not infer a quote from `ready` alone.
features.limits: A single snapshot cannot establish queue priority, fills, cancellations, latency, adverse selection, returns, or performance. Unit tests use explicitly synthetic fixtures and are not device/live-feed proof or statistical evidence.
features.location: Strategies → Quant model studio → Market making
features.name: Validation and no-plan/insufficient status
features.next_action: Fix a specifically named missing prerequisite or stop. Performance claims require at least 100 independent resolved quote outcomes with actual queue/fill/cancel/latency records, chronological walk-forward, and a one-use untouched OOS holdout.
features.output: Validation is always unconfirmed with 0 actual/train/test samples, no chronological walk-forward, and no untouched holdout. `ready` without a plan can mean the cost gate suppressed quotes; `insufficient-data` identifies a failed input/bound/book prerequisite; `unavailable` means no viable tick-grid pair or lot-compliant capacity could be emitted.
features.purpose: Answer whether the result is merely calculable or whether performance has actually been validated.

guide_note: Read the received venue book, cost assumptions and inventory settings together. The model produces research references from that book; it does not place or simulate queue fills.

name: Quant systematic trend / macro

features.how_to_use: Open the family, Load real-data starter and Run model; use Edit model / markets / settings for changes. Provide 2–8 distinct symbols, all on the same 1d or 1w timeframe, with non-empty source labels, provider/user-import provenance, fetchedAt in Unix milliseconds, and valid candles whose times are Unix seconds; pass finite now in Unix milliseconds. Supply up to 5,000 bars per asset and enough exact common completed timestamps. The runner excludes unfinished/future bars and omits invalid, duplicate, or non-common records without repair or filling.
features.limits: Needs 2–8 usable assets and at least max(effective trend bars, volatility bars)+3 common completed bars. Only daily/weekly input; no resampling, gap filling, synthetic-bar repair, automatic total-return adjustment, FX conversion, or financing/roll adjustments.
features.location: Strategies → Quant model studio → Multi-asset trend
features.name: Asset OHLC histories and alignment
features.next_action: Resolve every input reason, check source and timestamp conventions, and supply enough common bars before interpreting results.
features.output: Either an insufficient-data result with reasons, or accepted aligned histories with source/provenance metadata and notes about omitted records.
features.purpose: Assess slow trend direction across a small set of aligned markets using real, sourced, completed OHLC data.

features.how_to_use: In Edit settings choose an integer lookback 20–252. Default 60. The app does not accept arbitrary fractional settings; daily/weekly same-frame common histories are required.
features.limits: Lookback is observed common bars, not calendar time. No parameter optimization or claim of optimality.
features.location: Strategies → Quant model studio → Multi-asset trend
features.name: Trend lookback control
features.next_action: Select a horizon appropriate to the bar frequency and ensure histories meet the resulting common-bar requirement.
features.output: Effective trend lookback metric and a close-to-close trend for each asset at the prior completed common bar.
features.purpose: Set the slow close-to-close horizon used to determine trend direction.

features.how_to_use: Open the family, Load real-data starter and Run model; use Edit model / markets / settings for changes. No separate control. For each period, trend and volatility use the prior completed common bar. The volatility window is clamp(floor(effective lookback/3), 10, 63); the runner calculates population standard deviation of observed close-to-close returns and inverse-volatility weights, normalized by gross absolute exposure.
features.limits: No annualization across irregular intervals, execution/fill model, leverage/margin, liquidity, short availability, borrow, carry, or financing. Latest signals are next-bar targets and excluded from historical equity.
features.location: Strategies → Quant model studio → Multi-asset trend
features.name: Inverse-volatility directional targets
features.next_action: Inspect targets as research outputs against underlying data and independent validation; do not submit them as orders. Treat flat as zero assigned weight, not an order instruction.
features.output: Per-asset timestamp, long/short/flat direction, capped strength score, and explanatory reason. Zero trend or effectively zero volatility receives zero weight rather than an invented volatility floor.
features.purpose: Translate trend sign and relative realized volatility into long, short, or zero-weight research targets.

features.how_to_use: Open the family, Load real-data starter and Run model; use Edit model / markets / settings for changes. Supply positive finite startingEquity and feeBps and slippageBps each between 0 and 1,000. Zero is permitted. The runner deducts user costs using target-weight turnover, then applies weighted close-to-close period returns.
features.limits: No venue/spread/impact estimate, financing, borrow, roll, dividends, FX, tax, intrabar fills, gap execution, or margin model. Nonpositive equity is stopped at zero.
features.location: Strategies → Quant model studio → Multi-asset trend
features.name: Historical equity and user cost inputs
features.next_action: Use defensible instrument/venue-specific assumptions and account separately for omitted frictions; do not treat the result as a validated backtest or performance claim.
features.output: Equity series and starting/ending equity, net historical calculation return, close-to-close maximum drawdown, one-way turnover, entered fees/slippage, and user-cost deduction.
features.purpose: Calculate how the delayed target-weight rule evolves over supplied close-to-close history after explicitly entered costs.

features.how_to_use: Open the family, Load real-data starter and Run model; use Edit model / markets / settings for changes. For a ready result, review summary, source metric, metrics, dated equity, signal reasons, validation reasons, dataRequirements, and limitations. A ready status means inputs passed calculation gates, not model validation.
features.limits: Synthetic unit fixtures test algorithm behavior only; they are not device proof, real-data evidence, or statistical-edge evidence.
features.location: Strategies → Quant model studio → Multi-asset trend
features.name: Metrics, provenance, and validation reporting
features.next_action: Use results to inspect data/assumptions and plan separate independent out-of-sample validation; do not interpret 100 observations alone as proof of an edge.
features.output: Model and timeframe, asset count, effective windows, causal observation count, equity metrics, source/provenance, and signals. Validation is always unconfirmed: train/test samples 0, walk-forward false, untouched holdout false. The code calls 100 real independent OOS observations a minimum review gate and says no such process/holdout is supplied or claimed.
features.purpose: Show what data and assumptions were used, what the calculation produced, and whether independent evidence exists.

features.how_to_use: This capability exposes no macro release/vintage or rate-differential model. Do not read its OHLC trend calculation as one.
features.limits: Required point-in-time macro, rate and carry inputs are not inferred from OHLC.
features.location: Strategies → Quant model studio → Multi-asset trend
features.name: Macro release/vintage and rate-differential model
features.next_action: Use a separately documented research process with point-in-time releases, forecast/revision vintages, availability timestamps, rate curves or carry, return conventions and matched total-return prices.
features.output: No macro release/vintage or rate-differential result is available in the current capability.
features.purpose: State the current boundary for questions about point-in-time economic releases, revisions, expectations, or policy/sovereign-rate differentials.

guide_note: Run the documented multi-asset trend calculation from its supplied price history. This module does not expose a macro release, revision-vintage or rate-differential model.

name: Quant forward-return classification model

features.how_to_use: The app classifier uses exactly one selected market. Load real-data starter (BTC daily 900 bars) or supply its actual source-labelled matching history, then inspect quality/outcome counts and exclusions.
features.limits: App input is one market, requested history 60–1,800 bars or up to 5,000 valid imported bars. The internal pure runner can handle separate series, but the UI does not offer a combined ML portfolio. Gaps are retained; no data is invented.
features.location: Strategies → Quant model studio → Forward-return classifier
features.name: Historical OHLC intake and quality checks
features.next_action: Correct timestamps or malformed records and add closed history until outcome counts meet requirements; rerun and verify the intended series/source before interpreting model metrics.
features.output: Per-series closed valid bar and eligible outcome counts, supplied source/provenance, and reasons for malformed records, duplicates, open/future bars and irregular gaps. Duplicate times retain the first supplied record; gaps are kept without filling.
features.purpose: Test one selected market/timeframe series while filtering malformed/open/future records and showing data-quality exclusions.

features.how_to_use: Open the family, Load real-data starter and Run model; use Edit model / markets / settings for changes. Set lookback to an integer 10–60 (shared default 60), holdingBars to 1–20 (default 5), and finite nonnegative feeBps/slippageBps (both defaults 0). Enter positive startingEquity (default 100,000) only if you want an equity path. Use realistic costs rather than assuming zero-cost execution.
features.limits: App classifier is one selected market, lookback 10–60 and holding 1–20. Costs are entered assumptions; spread/impact/borrow/funding are not invented. Unused shared settings do not change this model.
features.location: Strategies → Quant model studio → Forward-return classifier
features.name: ML parameter settings
features.next_action: Choose settings that match the research question and user-supplied cost assumptions, then rerun and inspect the resulting sample counts and warnings.
features.output: Invalid settings return insufficient-data with a reason. A metric reports modeled round-trip costs; a valid positive startingEquity enables holdout equity points.
features.purpose: Control feature lookback, outcome horizon, modeled fees/slippage and optional hypothetical holdout equity starting amount.

features.how_to_use: Open the family, Load real-data starter and Run model; use Edit model / markets / settings for changes. Provide valid history and ML settings, then run the ML computation. There is no separate user-selectable algorithm in this module. Long/short returns use entry open and horizon exit close, deduct modeled costs, and omit outcomes where neither side is net positive.
features.limits: Strength is a normalized ensemble margin, not calibrated probability. No profitability or edge claim is established. Volume is not a classifier feature; no AI, fetch, retraining service or orders are invoked.
features.location: Strategies → Quant model studio → Forward-return classifier
features.name: Costed forward-return labels and bounded classifier
features.next_action: Treat a produced direction as an exploratory research result; independently assess data, costs and robustness before using it in any paper-only decision process.
features.output: A deterministic train-scaled ensemble of up to six shallow decision stumps. Six features are used: one-bar return, five-bar return, candle range/close, lookback close return, close position within trailing high-low range, and rolling standard deviation of one-bar returns.
features.purpose: Evaluate whether lagged OHLC features distinguish which side has positive modeled net return over the selected observation horizon.

features.how_to_use: Open the family, Load real-data starter and Run model; use Edit model / markets / settings for changes. Inspect walk-forward and holdout accuracy together with their sample counts and the data-requirement reasons. Do not interpret an accuracy without its count, and note that failed-to-fit folds contribute no scored rows.
features.limits: The 100 aggregate holdout-outcome threshold is a warning, not a gate on status or metrics. walkForward/untouchedHoldout indicate at least one scored row, not statistical acceptance. Unit fixture passes are not market evidence or device proof.
features.location: Strategies → Quant model studio → Forward-return classifier
features.name: Chronological walk-forward and untouched-holdout diagnostics
features.next_action: Use these as preliminary diagnostics only; seek independent validation across time periods, sources, assets and realistic costs before considering any action.
features.output: Three purged chronological development folds and a most-recent holdout; per-series holdout size is at least 20 rows or 20% of eligible rows, whichever is larger. Aggregate metrics report scored walk-forward and holdout direction accuracy and counts.
features.purpose: Provide chronology-aware direction-accuracy diagnostics rather than relying only on in-sample fit.

features.how_to_use: Open the family, Load real-data starter and Run model; use Edit model / markets / settings for changes. Inspect signal symbol, direction, timestamp, strength and source/provenance reason after confirming the latest bar is closed and the input series is intended. If no signal is returned, read the reasons; absence is not a neutral recommendation.
features.limits: No flat signal, trade sizing, multi-leg plan, order queue or order placement is implemented. Insufficient-data/no signal is not a bearish, bullish or flat conclusion.
features.location: Strategies → Quant model studio → Forward-return classifier
features.name: Latest per-series research direction
features.next_action: At most use it as an input to separate human-reviewed paper research; do not route directly to brokerage execution.
features.output: At most one long/short research signal per processed series, timestamped at the latest closed-bar boundary, with an explicitly uncalibrated/unconfirmed margin explanation.
features.purpose: Show the final fitted model's direction for the latest closed OHLC-derived feature vector per series.

features.how_to_use: Open the family, Load real-data starter and Run model; use Edit model / markets / settings for changes. Supply positive startingEquity, then inspect emitted points only as a diagnostic. Without a valid positive amount, the path is empty and a reason is reported.
features.limits: Independent per-symbol paths retain symbol identity. A single series may expose its singular equity path; multiple series do not become an unlabeled combined portfolio. No fills or extra frictions are inferred.
features.location: Strategies → Quant model studio → Forward-return classifier
features.name: Optional modeled holdout equity path
features.next_action: Validate assumptions and use an explicitly defined portfolio-level simulation if comparing multiple assets; do not treat the output as an account or realized performance curve.
features.output: Time/value points after predicted holdout exits; trades are spaced so holding intervals do not overlap and values are floored at zero.
features.purpose: Show a hypothetical compounded path for non-overlapping model-predicted holdout outcomes using user starting equity and modeled net returns.

guide_note: Inspect source quality, label construction, chronological splits and held-out counts before reading a classifier output. Current results are bounded research diagnostics, not predictive probabilities.

name: Private workspace and reliability tools
guide_note: Owner-only purpose and current boundaries for the 18 October repair. Operational means available code/function, not a universal device or statistical certification.

features.name: Automatic sync and conflict recovery
features.purpose: Preserve owner edits across reconnects without silently overwriting another revision.
features.how_to_use: Watch sync status; resolve an explicit revision conflict before destructive actions.
features.output: Local/confirmed-cloud status and last successful sync time.
features.next_action: Confirm reconnection and persistence on your phone.
features.limits: A lost connection is not a confirmed cloud save; close-to-background edits still need device testing.

features.name: Encrypted original preview and PDF evidence
features.purpose: Compare inferred rules against the authoritative retained file.
features.how_to_use: Open a retained source, navigate its pages, zoom/pan the preview and jump to the quoted evidence.
features.output: Bounded private image/page beside text evidence.
features.next_action: Correct extracted rules before approval.
features.limits: Original bytes stay owner-only; previews are rasterized/downscaled, not public share links.

features.name: Durable source analysis and retry
features.purpose: Avoid losing an original because a long scan timed out or the phone closed.
features.how_to_use: Upload, watch the retained job phases, then reload or explicitly retry the same source version after a reported failure.
features.output: Owner job ID, progress, failed recovery and an unapproved source proposal.
features.next_action: Review the source version and proposal.
features.limits: A published durable worker is still needed for reliable unattended execution; interrupted work is not claimed completed.

features.name: Archive capacity and dependency-confirmed delete
features.purpose: Retire strategies without filling the active cap, and delete only after reviewing links.
features.how_to_use: Inspect active/archive capacity and the dependency preview before confirming a specific removal.
features.output: Atomic removal or a revision conflict; canonical paper history retained.
features.next_action: Retry if edits changed after confirmation.
features.limits: Hard deletion is destructive and explicitly confirmed; imports cannot silently activate strategies.

features.name: Private ZIP/CSV/JSON import and export
features.purpose: Keep a portable owner copy of settings, rules, journal and structured paper data.
features.how_to_use: Export the local private ZIP; preview an import and confirm its exact merge.
features.output: CSV/JSON files and a versioned metadata manifest.
features.next_action: Check counts and preserve the export securely.
features.limits: Secrets, auth state and original encrypted file bytes are not included; no public hosted link is created.

features.name: Personal AI request limits and countdown
features.purpose: Make overload protection predictable instead of appearing broken.
features.location: My Library → AI request limits; Coach
features.how_to_use: Choose 1–60 requests per 10-minute window for Coach/Forecast and save; use the displayed reset countdown after rejection.
features.output: Durable owner counters and confirmed private limits.
features.next_action: Wait for the shown reset or review your chosen limit.
features.limits: These are internal workspace safeguards, not a service account balance; status checks do not consume asks.

features.name: Optional local PIN and background privacy
features.purpose: Mask an already-authenticated workspace when leaving the app.
features.how_to_use: Opt in with a confirmed PIN, use Lock now, and verify inactive/background recovery; forgotten-PIN recovery returns through owner sign-in.
features.output: Local lock and optional background mask.
features.next_action: Test on the actual phone before relying on it.
features.limits: Server ownership remains mandatory; local masking alone cannot guarantee operating-system screenshot protection.

features.name: Visual quantitative rule drafts
features.purpose: Research a transparent condition/allocation graph instead of arbitrary code.
features.how_to_use: Save a reviewed draft and run it on actual supported source history.
features.output: Condition checks, rankings, inverse-volatility allocation and source limitations.
features.next_action: Review a separate confluence gate before any strategy paper entry.
features.limits: A rule run neither places a trade nor replaces statistical validation; unavailable corporate-action/sector data is not invented.

features.name: Clock selection and explicit personal guards
features.purpose: Separate regional time context from enforced versus advisory discipline.
features.location: Chart → Timezone clocks; Paper ticket → Discipline
features.how_to_use: Choose the supported UTC/IANA/fixed-offset clock settings and explicitly configure each personal pause/count guard.
features.output: DST-aware clocks, guard classifications and a duration value.
features.next_action: Check the display across a DST boundary on your phone.
features.limits: Changing a display timezone does not change candle timestamps; broker risk controls remain server-owned.

features.name: Per-position server-processing evidence
features.purpose: Distinguish active-app observation from actual scheduled bracket management.
features.how_to_use: Read the badge and last scheduled update; opt into paper management only with understood limitations.
features.output: Dated processing evidence for the actual managed position.
features.next_action: Provide failed-Publish logs before activation and force-quit testing.
features.limits: Unpublished/stale/no-worker evidence remains Foreground only; no brokerage orders are sent.
